name: American Banking Association (ABA) routing number
doc: In the United States, an ABA routing transit number (ABA RTN) is a nine-digit code printed on the bottom of checks to identify the financial institution on which it was drawn.

name: Australian ABN (Australian Business Number) by known name
doc: Australian ABN (Australian Business Number) by known name identifier

ru.doc: Научная степень персоны на русском языке. Например, кандидат технических наук

patterns.name: Academic degree (Russian)
patterns.doc: Academic degree title in Russian.

name: Academic and professional title
doc: Title written before a person's name that shows an academic degree, an academic rank or a professional status, such as Dr, Prof. or Eur Ing. Degrees and qualifications written after the name, such as PhD, are name suffixes (namesuffix).

holder of the academic rank of professor
engineer registered as a European Engineer

name: Access token
doc: Bearer token that grants access to an API on behalf of a user or an application, such as an OAuth 2.0 access or refresh token or a personal access token. Formats differ by service.

name: Singapore ACRA (Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority) number by known name
doc: Singapore ACRA (Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority) number by known name identifier

name: Andorran tax registration number (NRT)
doc: Número de Registre Tributari, the identifier that the Andorran tax administration gives to natural and legal persons. It has eight characters: a letter for the kind of taxpayer, six digits and a control letter. The parts are often separated by hyphens.

examples.description: Synthetic number in the documented format
Synthetic number in the documented format
The first example in its printed form

name: Address (physical location)
doc: Geographic address, commonly consist of postindex, country, area, town, street and building

ru.name: Адрес (физическое местонахождение)
ru.doc: Географический или административный адрес местонахождения. Может включать почтовый индекс, название страны, региона, города, улицы и здания.

name: Address line 2 (secondary address line)
doc: Additional line of a postal address after the street line. It holds the part of a building or the delivery point: apartment, suite, unit, floor, building name or PO box, such as Apt 4B or Suite 200. Forms often have two or three such lines.

name: Dubai Multi Commodities Centre company number (DMCC)
doc: Number of a company registered with the Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC), a free zone authority in Dubai. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AE-DMCC; with that prefix an identifier reads AE-DMCC-JLT-65609.

name: UAE Bank Account Number
doc: UAE bank account number

examples.description: Example UAE bank account number (IBAN format)

name: UAE City Name
doc: UAE city name

name: UAE Emirates ID Number
doc: UAE Emirates ID number used for identification of UAE citizens and residents

name: UAE IBAN
doc: UAE IBAN (International Bank Account Number)

name: UAE Passport Number
doc: UAE passport number used for international travel identification

name: UAE Postal Code
doc: UAE postal code

name: UAE Tax Number
doc: UAE tax identification number (TRN - Tax Registration Number)

name: Afghan Central Business Registry number
doc: Number of a company in the Afghanistan Central Business Registry. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AF-CBR; with that prefix an identifier reads AF-CBR-102164.

name: Afghan NGO registration number
doc: Number that the NGO Department of the Ministry of Economy of Afghanistan gives to the non-governmental organisations it registers. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AF-MOE; with that prefix an identifier reads AF-MOE-89.

name: Afghan taxpayer identification number (TIN)
doc: Tax identification number of taxpayers in Afghanistan, including companies, charities and trusts. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AF-TIN; with that prefix an identifier reads AF-TIN-9000082348.

name: Age
doc: Age of the person or organization in years

name: Age range
doc: Range of ages in years that groups people, such as 18-24, 65+ or <18. Surveys, census tables and marketing data use it instead of an exact age.

name: Aircraft/tail number
doc: An aircraft registration, alternatively called a tail number, is a code unique to a single aircraft, required by international convention to be marked on the exterior of every civil aircraft.

name: Airline call sign
doc: Unique call sign of the airline

name: Airline code
doc: Unique code of the airline provided by IATA or ICAP

patterns.name: IATA airline designator (airline code)
patterns.doc: IATA airline designators, sometimes called IATA reservation codes, are two-character codes assigned by the International Air Transport Association (IATA) to the worlds airlines.

patterns.name: ICAO Airline code
patterns.doc: The ICAO airline designator is a code assigned by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) to aircraft operating agencies, aeronautical authorities, and services related to international aviation, each of which is allocated both a three-letter designator and a telephony designator.

name: Airline name
doc: Unique name of the airline

name: Airport location identifier
doc: A location identifier is a symbolic representation for the name and the location of an airport, navigation aid, or weather station, and is used for staffed air traffic control facilities in air traffic control, telecommunications, computer programming, weather reports, and related services.

patterns.name: FAA airport code (FAA identifier)
patterns.doc: The Federal Aviation Administration location identifier (FAA LID) is a three- to five-character alphanumeric code identifying aviation related facilities inside the United States, though some codes are reserved for, and are managed by other entities.

patterns.name: IATA Airport code
patterns.doc: An IATA airport code, also known as an IATA location identifier, IATA station code, or simply a location identifier, is a three-letter geocode designating many airports and metropolitan areas around the world, defined by the International Air Transport Association (IATA)

patterns.name: ICAO Airport code
patterns.doc: The ICAO airport code or location indicator is a four-letter code designating aerodromes around the world. These codes, as defined by the International Civil Aviation Organization and published in ICAO Document 7910: Location Indicators, are used by air traffic control and airline operations such as flight planning.

name: Albanian taxpayer identification number (NIPT)
doc: Numri i Identifikimit për Personin e Tatueshëm (NIPT, also NUIS), the tax number that Albania gives to businesses and individuals. It has ten characters: a letter, eight digits and a final letter. The leading characters encode the registration date, or the birth date of an individual. The check letter algorithm is not published.

examples.description: Synthetic number in the documented format
Synthetic number in the documented format

sq.name: Numri i Identifikimit për Personin e Tatueshëm (NIPT)

name: Authoritative Legal Entity Identifier (ALEI, IBRN)
doc: Globally unique identifier of a legal entity defined by ISO 8000-116. It combines a prefix for the jurisdiction and the register that created the entity with the local registration number from that register, for example US-DE.BER:3031657. Unlike proxy identifiers such as the LEI or the DUNS number, it is issued by the authority that registers the entity. The International Business Registration Number (IBRN) is the name used for ALEIs in trade.

examples.description: Entity in the Delaware Business Entity Register

name: Armenian Bank Account Number
doc: Armenian bank account number used for financial transactions

hy.name: Բանկային հաշիվ
hy.doc: Բանկային հաշիվ - Հայաստանում ֆինանսական գործարքների համար օգտագործվող հաշվեհամար

name: Armenian Driver License Number
doc: Armenian driver license number used for vehicle operation authorization

hy.name: Վարորդական իրավունք
hy.doc: Վարորդական իրավունք - Հայաստանում մեքենա վարելու թույլտվություն

name: Armenian legal entity state registration number
doc: State registration number of a legal entity in the register of the State Register Agency of Legal Entities of the Ministry of Justice of Armenia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AM-SRALE; with that prefix an identifier reads AM-SRALE-16.110.00666.

name: Armenian Organization Taxpayer Identification Number
doc: Armenian organization Taxpayer Identification Number used for tax purposes to identify businesses and organizations

hy.name: Կազմակերպության հարկային համար
hy.doc: Կազմակերպության հարկային համար - բիզնեսների և կազմակերպությունների հարկային համակարգում նույնականացման համար

name: Armenian Passport Number
doc: Armenian passport number used for international travel identification

hy.name: Հայտարարագիր
hy.doc: Հայտարարագիր - Հայաստանի քաղաքացիների միջազգային ճանապարհորդության նույնականացման փաստաթուղթ

name: Armenian Postal Code
doc: Armenian postal code used for mail delivery and addressing

hy.name: Փոստային ինդեքս
hy.doc: Փոստային ինդեքս - Հայաստանում փոստային առաքման և հասցեավորման համար օգտագործվող 4-նիշ կոդ

name: Armenian Social Security Number
doc: Armenian Social Security Number (SSN) is a 10-digit unique identifier assigned to Armenian citizens, legally residing foreigners, stateless individuals, and refugees. Generated based on personal information such as gender and date of birth, it remains constant throughout an individual's lifetime.

hy.name: Հասարակական ապահովագրության համար
hy.doc: Հասարակական ապահովագրության համար - 10-նիշ եզակի նույնականացման համար, որը տրվում է Հայաստանի քաղաքացիներին, օրինականորեն բնակվող օտարերկրացիներին, անքաղաքացիներին և փախստականներին

name: Armenian Taxpayer Identification Number
doc: Armenian Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) used for tax purposes to identify individuals and entities within the tax system. Mandatory for public sector systems.

hy.name: Հարկ վճարողի նույնականացման համար
hy.doc: Հարկ վճարողի նույնականացման համար - հարկային համակարգում անհատների և կազմակերպությունների նույնականացման համար օգտագործվող համար

name: Armenian Vehicle Registration Plate
doc: Armenian vehicle registration plate. Format consists of two or three numbers, two letters, and two or three additional numbers. Plates include the international code "AM" and feature the national flag, security hologram, and machine-readable Data Matrix Code (since 2014).

examples.description: Example Armenian vehicle plate (2 digits, 2 letters, 3 digits)
Example Armenian vehicle plate (3 digits, 2 letters, 2 digits)

hy.name: Մեքենայի համարանիշ
hy.doc: Մեքենայի համարանիշ - Հայաստանում ավտոմեքենաների գրանցման համարանիշ, որը բաղկացած է թվերից և տառերից

name: Animal
doc: Common name of an animal or a kind of animal, such as dog, cat or horse. Typical columns hold pet types, livestock or animals in observation records.

name: API key or client secret
doc: Secret string that an application presents to an API or an identity provider to authenticate itself, such as an API key, a subscription key or an OAuth client secret. Formats differ by service.

purview: Azure Machine Learning web service API key

name: Argentine uniform bank account code (CBU)
doc: Clave Bancaria Uniforme, the 22-digit code that identifies a customer account at a bank in Argentina. The first block holds a 3-digit bank code, a 4-digit branch code and a check digit; the second block holds a 13-digit account number and another check digit.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit
The first example in its printed form

name: Argentine community organisation number (CENOC)
doc: Number of a civil society organisation in the register of the National Centre of Community Organisations (Centro Nacional de Organizaciones de la Comunidad, CENOC) of Argentina. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AR-CENOC; with that prefix an identifier reads AR-CENOC-9316-A.

name: Argentina DNI (National Identity Document)
doc: Documento Nacional de Identidad or DNI (which means National Identity Document) is the main identity document for Argentine citizens, as well as temporary or permanent resident aliens (DNI Extranjero).

name: Archival Resource Key (ARK)
doc: Persistent identifier for digital, physical or abstract objects, used by libraries, archives, publishers and research institutions. The core is ark:<NAAN>/<name>, where the Name Assigning Authority Number (NAAN) identifies the organization that named the object. Older ARKs write ark:/<NAAN>/<name>. An ARK can be prefixed with the host of a resolver, such as n2t.net or the host of the institution that serves the object. The NAAN registry is kept by the ARK Alliance.

examples.description: Bibliothèque nationale de France authority record for Paris
The same ARK without the slash after ark:
The same ARK with a resolver host

name: Article ID by field name
doc: Article ID by field name identifier

name: Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN)
doc: Ten-character code of uppercase letters and digits that Amazon and its partners assign to a product in the Amazon catalog. For a book with a 10-digit ISBN, the ASIN is that ISBN. Other products, including most Kindle editions, get a code assigned by Amazon.

examples.description: Book: the ASIN is its ISBN-10

ru.name: Идентификатор товара Amazon (ASIN)
ru.doc: Десятисимвольный код товара в каталоге Amazon; для книг совпадает с ISBN-10.

name: Autonomous system number (ASN)
doc: autonomous system number

name: Austrian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Austria. Microsoft Purview looks for eight digits.

name: Austrian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Austria. Microsoft Purview looks for a letter, an optional space and seven digits.

name: Austrian postal code
doc: Postal code (Postleitzahl) in Austria: four digits. The first digit is the region, 1 for Vienna.

name: Austrian tax identification number
doc: Austrian tax number (Steuernummer): a two-digit tax office code, three digits and four digits, often written with a hyphen and a slash.

name: Austrian VAT identification number (UID)
doc: Austrian VAT identification number (Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer, UID). In the EU form it is ATU followed by eight digits. The last digit is a check digit.

name: Austrian social insurance number (VNR)
doc: Versicherungsnummer (also SVNR or VSNR), the personal number of the Austrian social insurance. It has ten digits: a 3-digit serial number, a check digit and six digits that usually hold the date of birth (DDMMYY).

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

purview: EU Social Security Number (SSN) or Equivalent ID
EU social security number or equivalent identification

name: Austrian association register number (ZVR-Zahl)
doc: ZVR-Zahl, the number of an association (Verein) in the Central Register of Associations (Zentrales Vereinsregister) of Austria. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AT-ZVR; with that prefix an identifier reads AT-ZVR-555769679.

name: Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) Classification System
doc: The Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) Classification System is a drug classification system that classifies the active ingredients of drugs according to the organ or system on which they act and their therapeutic, pharmacological and chemical properties. Its purpose is an aid to monitor drug use and for research to improve quality medication use. It does not imply drug recommendation or efficacy.

ru.name: Анатомо-терапевтическо-химическая классификация (АТХ)
ru.doc: Анатомо-терапевтическо-химическая классификация — международная система классификации лекарственных средств.

name: Austrian city name (in German)
doc: Austrian city name in German language

name: Australian bank account number
doc: Number of a bank account held in Australia. Microsoft Purview looks for six to ten digits; the bank state branch (BSB) number is written separately.

name: Australian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Australia. Microsoft Purview looks for the formats of all states and territories: six to ten digits, six letters and digits, or digit groups separated by spaces or hyphens.

name: Australian postcode
doc: Postcode in Australia: four digits. Codes in the Northern Territory start with 0, such as 0800 for Darwin.

name: Australian state or territory
doc: Name of one of the six states of Australia (New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, Western Australia, South Australia, Tasmania) or of its two mainland territories (Australian Capital Territory, Northern Territory). The abbreviation is the pattern au_state_code.

patterns.name: Australian state or territory abbreviation
patterns.doc: Abbreviation of an Australian state or mainland territory, as written in addresses: ACT, NSW, NT, QLD, SA, TAS, VIC or WA. ISO 3166-2:AU uses the same letters after AU-.

name: Australian state or territory abbreviation
doc: Abbreviation of an Australian state or mainland territory, as written in addresses: ACT, NSW, NT, QLD, SA, TAS, VIC or WA. ISO 3166-2:AU uses the same letters after AU-.

name: Australian suburb or locality
doc: Name of a suburb or locality of Australia: the place named in a postal address before the state and the postcode, such as Parramatta or Fitzroy.

name: Australian Business Number (ABN)
doc: The Australian Business Number (ABN) is a unique 11-digit identifier issued by the Australian Business Register (ABR) which is operated by the Australian Taxation Office (ATO).

name: Australian Company Number (ACN)
doc: An Australian Company Number (usually shortened to ACN) is a unique identifier required by every company registered under Australia’s Corporations Act 2001 (Cth).

name: Australia bank state branch (BSB) code
doc: A bank state branch is the name used in Australia for a bank code, which is a branch identifier.

name: Australian medicare number
doc: Medicare number is a unique identifier issued by Australian Government that enables the cardholder to receive a rebates of medical expenses under Australia Medicare system.

name: Australian passport number
doc: Number of Australian National passport

name: Australian Tax File Number (TFN)
doc: The tax file number (TFN) is a unique identifier issued by the Australian Taxation Office to each taxpaying entity — an individual, company, superannuation fund, partnership, or trust.

name: authentihash
doc: authentihash is a sha256 hash used by Microsoft to verify that the relevant sections of a PE image file have not been altered. This specific type of hash is used by Microsoft AppLocker.

name: Contract award notice id
doc: EU datatype for 'Contract award notice id' (awardnotice) from rules in context 'government'. The Contract Award Notice ID is a unique identifier assigned to contract award notices published in the Official Journal of the European Union. The identifier format consists of a 4-digit year, followed by '/S', then 1 to 3 digits representing the supplement number, a hyphen, and finally 1 to 5 digits representing the notice number within that supplement.

examples.description: Contract award notice ID with 4-digit year, 3-digit supplement, and 5-digit notice number
Contract award notice ID with 4-digit year, 2-digit supplement, and 4-digit notice number
Contract award notice ID with 4-digit year, single-digit supplement, and 3-digit notice number
Contract award notice ID with 4-digit year, 3-digit supplement, and single-digit notice number

es.name: ID de aviso de adjudicación de contrato

name: Air Waybill number by field name
doc: Air Waybill number by field name identifier

name: AWS access key ID
doc: Public half of an Amazon Web Services access key pair, sent with every signed API request together with the secret access key. It has 20 characters: the prefix AKIA for a long-term key of an IAM user or the root user, or ASIA for a temporary key issued by AWS STS, then 16 uppercase letters and digits.

examples.description: Example key ID from the AWS IAM documentation
Unique ID of an IAM user (prefix AIDA), not an access key

name: AWS account ID
doc: Twelve-digit number that identifies an Amazon Web Services account, for example in the account field of an ARN. AWS states that account IDs are not secret, but secret scanners report them because they help to target an account.

examples.description: Example account ID from the AWS IAM documentation

name: AWS secret access key
doc: Secret part of an Amazon Web Services access key pair, used with the access key ID to sign API requests (for example to Amazon S3): 40 letters, digits, slashes or plus signs.

purview: Amazon S3 client secret access key

name: Azerbaijani taxpayer identification number (VÖEN)
doc: VÖEN (vergi ödəyicisinin eyniləşdirmə nömrəsi), the 10-digit taxpayer identification number that also serves as the registration number of a commercial entity in the State Register of Commercial Entities of the Ministry of Taxes of Azerbaijan. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AZ-IVI; with that prefix an identifier reads AZ-IVI-3100073821.

name: Azure Storage account key
doc: Access key of an Azure Storage account: 512 bits encoded in Base64, which gives 86 characters followed by two equals signs.

name: Bosnian unique identification number (JIB)
doc: Jedinstveni identifikacioni broj (JIB), the unique tax identification number of legal entities in Bosnia and Herzegovina. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BA-JIB; with that prefix an identifier reads BA-JIB-200318240004.

name: Bank account
doc: A bank account is a financial account maintained by a bank or other financial institution in which the financial transactions between the bank and a customer are recorded.

ru.name: Банковский счет
ru.doc: Банковский счёт — счёт, открываемый банком юридическим или физическим лицам для их участия в безналичном денежном обороте и аккумулировании на счёте безналичных денежных средств для целевого использования.

patterns.name: Australian bank account number
patterns.doc: Number of a bank account held in Australia. Microsoft Purview looks for six to ten digits; the bank state branch (BSB) number is written separately.

patterns.name: Canadian bank account number
patterns.doc: Number of a bank account held in Canada. Microsoft Purview looks for seven or twelve digits.

patterns.name: Israeli bank account number
patterns.doc: Number of a bank account held in Israel. Microsoft Purview looks for 13 digits, or two, three and eight digits separated by hyphens.

patterns.name: Japanese bank account number
patterns.doc: Number of a bank account held in Japan. Microsoft Purview looks for seven or eight digits; the four-digit bank code and three-digit branch code are written separately.

patterns.name: Bank account in Russia
patterns.doc: Number of a bank account in a Russian bank (расчётный счёт): 20 digits.

patterns.name: Bank account in United States
patterns.doc: A bank account in the financial institutuin in United States

ru.name: Банковский счет в банке США
ru.doc: Вид банковского счета открываемого в банках США

name: Bank card (credit/debit card)
doc: A bank card is typically a plastic card issued by a bank to its clients that performs one or more of a number of services that relate to giving the client access to bank account.

ru.name: Банковская карта
ru.doc: Банковская карта (англ. bank card) — пластиковая, металлическая или виртуальная карта, обычно привязанная к одному или нескольким расчётным счетам в банке.

name: bcrypt password hash
doc: Password hash produced by bcrypt in Modular Crypt Format: $2, an optional version letter (a, b, x or y), $, a two-digit cost, $ and 53 characters of bcrypt Base64 (a 22-character salt and a 31-character hash).

examples.description: Hash of the word "example" made with htpasswd -B

name: Bangladeshi business identification number (BIN)
doc: Business Identification Number (BIN) on the VAT registration certificate that the National Board of Revenue of Bangladesh gives to registered organisations and companies. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BD-NBR; with that prefix an identifier reads BD-NBR-000697679-0101.

name: Bangladeshi NGO Affairs Bureau registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation at the NGO Affairs Bureau of Bangladesh. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BD-NAB; with that prefix an identifier reads BD-NAB-2330.

name: Bangladeshi RJSC registration number
doc: Registration number of a company, society or firm at the Office of the Registrar of Joint Stock Companies and Firms (RJSC) of Bangladesh. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BD-ROC; with that prefix an identifier reads BD-ROC-3-S123.

name: Belgian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Belgium. Microsoft Purview looks for ten digits.

name: Belgian IBAN
doc: International Bank Account Number of a bank account in Belgium. It has 16 characters: BE, two IBAN check digits, a 3-digit bank code, a 7-digit account number and two national check digits.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit
The first example in its printed form

name: Belgian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Belgium. Microsoft Purview looks for two letters and six digits.

name: Belgian postal code
doc: Four-digit postal code used in Belgium since 1969. The first digit mostly shows the province. bpost asks not to write a country prefix such as B- before the code.

examples.description: country prefix is not part of the code

name: Belgian enterprise number (VAT number)
doc: Ondernemingsnummer or numéro d'entreprise, the 10-digit number of a company in the Belgian Crossroads Bank for Enterprises. With the BE prefix it is also the VAT number (BTW, TVA). It starts with 0 or 1 and ends with two check digits; older numbers had nine digits.

name: Belgium national card ID
doc: Belgium identity card is a national identity card issued to all citizens of Belgium aged 12 years old and above.

purview: EU Social Security Number (SSN) or Equivalent ID
EU social security number or equivalent identification

name: Beverage
doc: Name of a drink or a kind of drink, such as coffee, tea, beer or orange juice, for example in menus, product catalogs or food surveys.

name: Burkinabé association registration number
doc: Registration number of an association at the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Decentralisation of Burkina Faso. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BF-MATD; with that prefix an identifier reads BF-MATD-RNRD00045.

name: Bulgarian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Bulgaria. Microsoft Purview looks for nine digits.

name: Bulgarian unified civil number (EGN)
doc: Единен граждански номер, the 10-digit personal number of Bulgarian citizens. The first six digits encode the date of birth (the month is shifted for births outside the 20th century), the next three are a birth order number that also gives the sex, and the last digit is a check digit.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: Bulgarian unified identification code (EIK)
doc: ЕИК (единен идентификационен код), the unified identification code under which a company is entered in the Commercial Register of Bulgaria. With the BG prefix it forms the VAT number (bg_vat). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BG-EIK; with that prefix an identifier reads BG-EIK-204853663.

name: Bulgarian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Bulgaria. Microsoft Purview looks for nine digits.

name: Bulgarian personal number of a foreigner (LNCh)
doc: Личен номер на чужденец, the 10-digit personal number given to foreigners who live in Bulgaria. The last digit is a weighted check digit.

name: Bulgarian postal code
doc: Postal code (пощенски код) in Bulgaria: four digits, from 1000 for central Sofia.

name: Bulgarian VAT identification number
doc: Bulgarian VAT identification number (ДДС номер). It is BG followed by 9 digits for legal entities or 10 digits for individuals, foreigners and others; a 10-digit number can be a personal number (EGN). The last digit is a check digit, with a different algorithm for each length.

name: Burundian tax identification number (NIF)
doc: Numéro d'identification fiscale (NIF), the tax identification number of taxpayers in Burundi, including companies, charities and trusts. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BI-NIF; with that prefix an identifier reads BI-NIF-4000742330.

name: Bibcode (ADS bibliographic code)
doc: Nineteen-character identifier of a publication in the NASA Astrophysics Data System (ADS) and other astronomy databases. Its fixed fields are the year (4 digits), the publication code (5 characters), the volume (4), a qualifier (1), the first page (4) and the initial of the first author's surname (1). Periods fill unused positions: 1970ApJ...161L..77K is a 1970 letter (L) in The Astrophysical Journal, volume 161, page 77, by Kemp and others. The qualifier can also hold a Physical Review issue as a lowercase letter, or the letter of an article number. The regexp is adapted from the Wikidata format of property P819, with any letter allowed as the qualifier.

examples.description: Eddington, Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

ru.name: Библиографический код ADS (bibcode)
ru.doc: Девятнадцатисимвольный идентификатор публикации в астрофизической системе данных NASA (ADS).

name: SWIFT/BIC code
doc: Datatype for 'SWIFT/BIC code' (bic) from rules in context 'finances'.

name: Russian bank identification code (BIK)
doc: Russian bank identification code used as unique identifier of a credit organization (bank) and issued by Bank of Russia

ru.name: Банковский идентификационный код
ru.doc: Банковский идентификационный код, БИК — уникальный идентификатор банка, используемый в платежных документах (платёжное поручение, аккредитив) на территории России. Классификатор БИКов ведёт Центробанк РФ (Банк России).

name: BIP-32 key
doc: The BIP-32 mainly describes the way of building the hierarchical deterministic wallet basing on the BIP-39 features. What does it mean? BIP-32 is exactly explaining how the bitcoin master private key and the master chain code is being created from delivered by BIP-39 bitcoin seed. The bitcoin seed generated by BIP-39 is the base for generating deterministic and hierarchical deterministic wallets.

name: Year of birth
doc: Year in which a person was born, written with four digits, for example 1984. Data sets publish it instead of the full date of birth to make people harder to identify, but it is still personal data.

examples.description: a full date of birth is the datatype birthday

name: Birthday
doc: A birthday is the anniversary of the birth of a person, or figuratively of an institution. Birthdays of people are celebrated in numerous cultures, often with birthday gifts, birthday cards, a birthday party, or a rite of passage.

ru.name: День рождения
ru.doc: День рождения — годовщина рождения, соответствует дате рождения человека.

name: Place of birth
doc: The place where a person was born, usually a city or town, often followed by the region or country, such as "Montreal, QC, CAN". Together with a name and a birth date it helps to identify a person, so it is personal data.

name: Beninese unique tax identifier (IFU)
doc: Identifiant fiscal unique (IFU), the tax identifier of taxpayers in Benin, including companies and public bodies. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BJ-IFU; with that prefix an identifier reads BJ-IFU-3200901353510.

name: BLAKE2b-256 hash
doc: Digest of the BLAKE2b hash function with a 256-bit output. It is written as 64 hexadecimal digits. SHA-256, Keccak-256 and BLAKE2b-256 digests have the same length, so the value alone does not tell them apart: use the field name or context.

examples.description: BLAKE2b-256 hash of the empty string
one hex digit short (63 instead of 64)

name: BLAKE2b-512 hash
doc: Digest of the BLAKE2b hash function with a 512-bit output. It is written as 128 hexadecimal digits. SHA-512, Keccak-512 and BLAKE2b-512 digests have the same length, so the value alone does not tell them apart: use the field name or context.

examples.description: BLAKE2b-512 hash of the empty string
one hex digit short (127 instead of 128)

name: Bolivian institutional classifier code
doc: Code of a public sector entity in the Bolivian Institutional Classifier (Clasificador Institucional). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BO-CINS; with that prefix an identifier reads BO-CINS-0065-10.

name: Bolivian tax identification number (NIT)
doc: Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT), the tax identification number of taxpayers in Bolivia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BO-NIT; with that prefix an identifier reads BO-NIT-301140029.

name: Boolean
doc: In computer science, the Boolean data type is a data type that has one of two possible values (usually denoted true and false) which is intended to represent the two truth values of logic and Boolean algebra.

ru.name: Логический тип
ru.doc: Логи́ческий тип да́нных, или булев тип, или булевый тип (от англ. Boolean или logical data type) — примитивный тип данных в информатике, принимающий два возможных значения, иногда называемых истиной (true) и ложью (false).

name: Brazilian municipality
doc: Name of a municipality (município) of Brazil, the level of local government below the state, such as São Paulo or Salvador. IBGE lists 5,570 of them, counting the Federal District; their codes are the pattern br_municipality_code.

patterns.name: Brazilian municipality code (IBGE)
patterns.doc: Seven-digit code of a Brazilian municipality assigned by IBGE, the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics. The first two digits are the code of the state, for example 35 for São Paulo, and the last digit is a check digit.

name: Brazilian municipality code (IBGE)

name: Brazilian postal code (CEP)
doc: Brazilian postal code (CEP, Código de Endereçamento Postal): eight digits, usually written as five digits, a hyphen and three digits.

name: Brazilian state (federative unit)
doc: Name of one of the 27 federative units of Brazil: the 26 states and the Federal District, such as São Paulo, Minas Gerais or Distrito Federal. The two-letter abbreviation is the pattern br_state_code.

patterns.name: Brazilian state abbreviation (UF)
patterns.doc: Two-letter abbreviation (sigla) of a Brazilian federative unit, such as SP for São Paulo or DF for the Federal District. ISO 3166-2:BR uses the same letters after BR-.

name: Brand
doc: Name of a brand, the name under which a product, a product line, a service or a store chain is sold. A brand can differ from the name of the company that owns it, so it is a separate type from the company name.

name: CPF number (Cadastro de Pessoas Fisicas)
doc: The CPF number (Cadastro de Pessoas Fisicas; Portuguese for Natural Persons Register) is the Brazilian individual taxpayer registry, since its creation in 1965.

name: Burgerservicenummer op veldnaam
doc: NL datatype for 'Burgerservicenummer op veldnaam' (bsn) from rules in context 'finances'. The Burgerservicenummer (BSN) is a unique 9-digit personal identification number assigned to every Dutch citizen and resident. It is used for identification in interactions with government agencies, healthcare providers, and for tax purposes. The BSN replaced the former Social Security Number (SoFi-nummer) in 2007. It consists of exactly 9 digits and uses an 11-proef (11-check) algorithm for validation.

name: Russian government budget code
doc: Budget codes issued by Ministry of Finances and Federal Treasury of Russia to all government and local budgets.

name: Canadian Drug Identification Number (DIN)
doc: Eight-digit number that Health Canada assigns to a drug product, for human or veterinary use, when it is authorized for sale in Canada. It is printed on the label. The Drug Product Database of Health Canada can be searched by DIN.

name: Canadian forward sortation area (FSA)
doc: First three characters of a Canadian postal code (ca_postcode): letter, digit, letter, for example K1A. A forward sortation area is the area covered by all postal codes that start with these characters. The letter is a postal district within one province or territory, and a 0 as the digit marks a rural area. Statistics Canada and other publishers release data and boundary files by FSA when full postal codes would be too detailed.

ru.doc: Первые три символа канадского почтового индекса, обозначающие район сортировки почты.

name: Government of Canada department number
doc: Number that the Receiver General gives to a federal department or agency of Canada that may use the Consolidated Revenue Fund, as published in the list of legal department names. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as CA-GOV; with that prefix an identifier reads CA-GOV-001.

name: Nova Scotia Registry of Joint Stock Companies number
doc: Number of a company, society or other entity in the Registry of Joint Stock Companies of Nova Scotia, Canada. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as CA_NS-NVS_NVE; with that prefix an identifier reads CA_NS-NVS_NVE-1542067.

CCAM (Classification Commune des Actes Médicaux) is the French common classification of medical procedures used in the French healthcare system. CCAM codes are used to identify and classify medical acts and procedures for billing, reimbursement, and statistical purposes. The format consists of exactly 4 characters: 1 uppercase letter, 2 digits, and 1 uppercase letter (e.g., A123B).

name: The Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance (CFDA) number
doc: CFDA numbers are the system for identifying and sorting the 2,000+ federal programs. Each CFDA number contains five digits and appears in the following format: ##.### (e.g., 10.001 or 98.102).

name: Colombian municipality

name: DDI agency identifier
doc: Identifier of an organization that maintains metadata in the Data Documentation Initiative (DDI) standard, such as a national statistics office, a data archive or a survey project. The organization registers it in the DDI Agency Registry in the form country code, dot, name (for example dk.dst; international bodies use int, as in int.esseric), and may extend it with sub-agency labels separated by dots (us.mpc.ipums). The DDI Lifecycle schema allows labels of letters, digits and hyphens, up to 63 characters each and 253 in total. It also accepts a single label, but the identifiers listed in the registry all have a prefix, so the regexp requires at least one dot and a first label of two or three letters (the country code or int). Without that, dates such as 01.01.2015 and decimal numbers matched. The agency identifier is the namespace part of DDI URNs (urn:ddi:<agency>:<id>:<version>) and the registration authority in ISO/IEC 11179-6 identifiers (IRDI).

doc: Eastward coordinate of a point in a projected coordinate reference system, such as a UTM zone or the British National Grid, usually in metres from a false origin. It is paired with a northing. Unlike longitude, its origin and scale depend on the projection, so the value has a meaning only together with its coordinate reference system.

unit and digit grouping are not part of the value

name: European Business Identifier (EBID)
doc: EBID, the identifier of a company or production site in the directory of German and Austrian companies of the CAS Group (Unternehmensverzeichnis.org). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZZ-EBID; with that prefix an identifier reads ZZ-EBID-2-500897-444478.

name: Ecuadorian identity card number (cédula)
doc: Cédula de identidad, the 10-digit number that identifies citizens of Ecuador. The first two digits are a province code and the last digit is a check digit.

name: Ecuadorian province
doc: Name of one of the 24 provinces of Ecuador, such as Pichincha, Guayas or Galápagos.

name: Ecuadorian taxpayer number (RUC)
doc: Registro Único de Contribuyentes, the 13-digit tax number in Ecuador. The third digit shows the kind of taxpayer: below 6 for natural persons (their cédula followed by an establishment number), 6 for public entities and 9 for private companies.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)
doc: Identifier of a court decision, introduced by conclusions of the Council of the European Union published in 2011. It has five parts separated by colons: ECLI, the country code, a court code of at most seven characters, the year of the decision and a unique part of at most 25 letters, digits and dots. Country codes follow the EU style guide, so Greece is EL and the United Kingdom UK; the EU courts use EU and the European Court of Human Rights CE.

Decision of the Czech Supreme Court

name: UN/EDIFACT message type
doc: Six-letter code that names a standard message of UN/EDIFACT, the United Nations rules for electronic data interchange in trade, transport and administration, for example ORDERS for a purchase order or INVOIC for an invoice. The code is written in the message header (UNH segment) together with the directory version. UN/CEFACT publishes the message types in each release of the UN/EDIFACT directories.

ru.name: Тип сообщения UN/EDIFACT
ru.doc: Код из шести заглавных букв, обозначающий стандартное сообщение UN/EDIFACT, например ORDERS (заказ) или INVOIC (счёт).

name: Estonian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Estonia. Microsoft Purview looks for the letters ET and six digits.

name: Estonian personal identification code (isikukood)
doc: Isikukood, the 11-digit personal code in Estonia. The first digit gives the sex and the century of birth, the next six the date of birth (YYMMDD), then come a 3-digit serial number and a check digit.

name: Estonian VAT number (KMKR)
doc: KMKR number (käibemaksukohustuslase registreerimisnumber), the 9-digit VAT registration number in Estonia. The last digit is a check digit.

name: Estonian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Estonia. Microsoft Purview looks for a letter and seven digits.

name: Estonian organisation registration code (registrikood)
doc: Registrikood, the 8-digit code that the Estonian registers give to organisations. Commercial companies start with 1, state and local government bodies with 7, non-profit associations with 8 and foundations with 9. The last digit is a check digit.

doc: Number of a company in the Commercial Registry of Egypt. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as EG-CR; with that prefix an identifier reads EG-CR-117508.

name: Egyptian NGO registration number

name: Elevation above sea level
doc: Height of a place, such as a mountain summit, a town or a weather station, above mean sea level. Datasets store it as a number in metres or feet, sometimes with the unit after the number. Places below sea level have negative values. Schema.org reads a number without a unit as metres.

name: Email (Electronic mail)
doc: Electronic mail (email or e-mail) is a method of exchanging messages ("mail") between people using electronic devices. Email was thus conceived as the electronic (digital) version of, or counterpart to, mail, at a time when "mail" meant only physical mail (hence e- + mail).

ru.doc: Электро́нная по́чта (англ. email, e-mail [iˈmeɪl], от англ. electronic mail) — технология и служба по пересылке и получению электронных сообщений (называемых «письма», «электронные письма» или «сообщения») между пользователями компьютерной сети (в том числе — Интернета).

doc: An ENI number (European Number of Identification or European Vessel Identification Number) is a registration for ships capable of navigating on inland European waters. It is a unique, eight-digit identifier that is attached to a hull for its entire lifetime, independent of the vessels current name or flag.

name: Ensembl stable ID (gene, transcript or protein)
doc: Stable identifier that the Ensembl genome database gives to a gene, transcript or protein of a vertebrate genome. It is ENS, a three-letter species code (none for human, MUS for mouse, RNO for rat, DAR for zebrafish), a feature letter (G for gene, T for transcript, P for protein) and eleven digits. A version suffix such as .8 may follow; it grows when the feature changes. Ensembl Genomes (plants, fungi, protists, bacteria) and some model organisms, such as fly and yeast, use other identifiers, which the regexp does not cover.

name: Ensembl gene ID
doc: Stable identifier of a gene in Ensembl, the genome database of EMBL-EBI. It is "ENS", a three-letter species code (none for human, MUS for mouse, GAL for chicken), the feature letter G for gene and eleven digits. A version number may follow after a dot. Transcripts (T), proteins (P) and exons (E) use the same scheme with their own letter and are not covered here.

name: Economic Operators Registration and Identification number (EORI)
doc: EORI number, the identifier of a business or other economic operator in the customs procedures of the European Union. It starts with the code of the country that issued it. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as XI-EORI; with that prefix an identifier reads XI-EORI-NL810656371.

name: Electronic Product Code (EPC) pure identity URI
doc: Identifier of one individual physical object in the GS1 EPC Tag Data Standard, written as a URN: urn:epc:id:<scheme>:<fields>. The scheme says which GS1 key is used, for example sgtin (a GTIN plus a serial number), sscc, sgln or grai. The fields hold the GS1 Company Prefix and the rest of the key separated by dots, without the check digit. The same identifier can be encoded in RFID tags and in barcodes.

examples.description: SGTIN of GS1's example GTIN 09506000134352 with serial number 1001
Tag URI, not a pure identity URI

doc: Etablissements publics de cooperation intercommunale (EPCI). French administrative geo code

name: Spanish bank account code (CCC)
doc: Código Cuenta Cliente, the 20-digit Spanish bank account number: a 4-digit bank code, a 4-digit office code, two check digits and a 10-digit account number. Since 2014 it is used inside the Spanish IBAN.

name: Spanish energy supply point code (CUPS)
doc: Código Unificado de Punto de Suministro, the identifier of an electricity or piped gas supply point in Spain. It has 20 or 22 characters: ES, a 4-digit distribution company code, a 12-digit supply point number, two check letters and, optionally, a border point digit and letter.

name: Spanish DIR3 code
doc: Code of an organisational unit or office of the Spanish public administration in the Common Directory of Organisational Units and Offices (Directorio Común de Unidades Orgánicas y Oficinas, DIR3). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ES-DIR3; with that prefix an identifier reads ES-DIR3-E04100802.

name: Spanish national identity document number (DNI)
doc: Documento Nacional de Identidad, the identity number of Spanish citizens: eight digits and a check letter, which is the number modulo 23 looked up in TRWAGMYFPDXBNJZSQVHLCKE. The same value is the person's tax number (NIF). Foreigners receive an NIE instead.

name: Spanish Ministry of Justice registration number
doc: Registration number of an organisation, such as a foundation or a religious entity, in one of the public registers of the Ministry of Justice of Spain. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ES-MDJ; with that prefix an identifier reads ES-MDJ-539SND.

name: Spanish social security number
doc: Spanish social security affiliation number (número de la Seguridad Social): a two-digit province code, seven or eight digits and two check digits, optionally separated by slashes.

name: Spanish province
doc: Name of one of the 50 provinces of Spain, such as Madrid, Barcelona or A Coruña, in Spanish or in a co-official language (Alacant). Ceuta and Melilla are autonomous cities outside the provinces.

name: Spanish cadastral reference (referencia catastral)
doc: Referencia catastral, the 20-character identifier that the Spanish Directorate General for Cadastre gives to a real estate property. It holds 14 characters for the parcel, 4 for the property within the parcel and 2 check letters; digits and letters, including Ñ, are used.

name: Spanish intra-Community VAT number (NIF-IVA)
doc: NIF-IVA, the Spanish VAT number for intra-Community trade: ES followed by the 9-character tax identification number (NIF). Spanish citizens use their DNI, eight digits and a check letter. Foreigners use their NIE, which starts with X, Y or Z. Companies and other entities have a NIF that starts with a letter for the legal form (formerly the CIF). The last character is a check digit or a check letter.

name: Ethiopian civil society organisation registration number
doc: Registration number of a civil society organisation at the Authority for Civil Society Organizations (ACSO) of Ethiopia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ET-CSA; with that prefix an identifier reads ET-CSA-1327.

name: Ethiopian taxpayer identification number (TIN)
doc: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of taxpayers in Ethiopia, including companies, charities and trusts. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ET-TIN; with that prefix an identifier reads ET-TIN-0000178477.

name: Ethiopian Ministry of Trade registration number
doc: Registration number of a company or other organisation at the Ministry of Trade of Ethiopia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ET-MOT; with that prefix an identifier reads ET-MOT-020/4/007.

name: Ethereum address
doc: Address of an Ethereum account or contract: 0x followed by 40 hexadecimal digits (the last 20 bytes of the Keccak-256 hash of the public key). Mixed upper and lower case encodes an EIP-55 checksum.

examples.description: EIP-55 test vector, all lower case

name: SEPA creditor identifier (AT-02)
doc: Creditor identifier of SEPA direct debits (data element AT-02 of the SEPA rulebooks, Creditor Scheme Identification in ISO 20022). It starts with the ISO country code and two ISO 7064 mod 97-10 check digits, followed by a 3-character creditor business code (ZZZ when not used) and a national identifier.

name: Euro banknote serial number
doc: Serial number printed on euro banknotes. Notes of the first series have one letter and eleven digits; notes of the Europa series have two letters and ten digits. The first letter shows the printing works, and all characters together form a simple checksum.

name: EU corporate body code
doc: Code of an institution, body or agency of the European Union in the corporate bodies authority list of the Publications Office of the EU. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as XR-EUCB; with that prefix an identifier reads XR-EUCB-ACP_MIN.

name: European Community (EC) number
doc: Seven-digit number of a chemical substance in the European Community inventory, which joins EINECS, ELINCS and the NLP list. It is written as three groups, NNN-NNN-N; the last digit is a check digit. The European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) maintains the inventory and uses the same form for its list numbers.

ru.doc: Номер химического вещества в перечне веществ Европейского сообщества (EINECS, ELINCS, NLP).

name: Energy Identification Code (EIC)
doc: Energy Identification Code, the 16-character code of the European electricity and gas sector for market participants, areas, metering points and other objects. It has a 2-character code of the issuing office, an object type letter, twelve characters for the object and a check character. Digits, capital letters and hyphens are used.

name: EudraCT number (EU Clinical Trials Register)
doc: Number of a clinical trial of a medicinal product in EudraCT, the European Union clinical trials database, and in the EU Clinical Trials Register that publishes it. The form is YYYY-NNNNNN-CC; the year when the number was issued, a six-digit sequence and a check number. The register may add a member state code to show one national protocol, as in 2006-002830-38/GB. EudraCT numbers were issued from 2004 until 2023; the Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) issues EU CT numbers instead.

name: NACE code (EU classification of economic activities)
doc: Code of NACE, the Statistical Classification of Economic Activities in the European Community and the EU version of the UN ISIC classification. A section is a single letter; divisions, groups and classes have two to four digits, usually written with a dot after the second digit. Revision 2.1 replaced revision 2 from 2025 and changed some codes.

examples.description: Class: growing of cereals, other than rice, leguminous crops and oil seeds

name: Craft Identification Number
doc: The Craft Identification Number (CIN) or Hull Identification Number (HIN), standardised as EN ISO 10087:2006, is a permanent unique fourteen-digit alphanumeric identifier issued to all marine vessels in Europe.

name: MAC address (Media Access Control)
doc: A media access control address (MAC address) is a unique identifier assigned to a network interface controller (NIC) for use as a network address in communications within a network segment.

name: European Unique Identifier (EUID)
doc: EU datatype for 'European Unique Identifier (EUID)' (euid) from rules in context 'finances'. The European Unique Identifier (EUID) is a unique identifier format used within the European Union. It consists of a 2-letter uppercase country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) followed by 4 to 18 alphanumeric characters (letters and/or digits), resulting in a total length of 6 to 20 characters. This identifier format is commonly used for financial and business identification purposes across EU member states.

doc: European Union geographic code, identifier for a region per NUTS

name: EU VAT number (VIES format)
doc: VAT identification number of a business registered for VAT in a European Union member state, in the compact form that the VIES system checks. It is the 2-letter code of the member state followed by the national number without spaces or punctuation. Greece uses EL rather than GR, and businesses in Northern Ireland use XI for trade in goods with the EU. Each member state has its own fixed structure for the national part, from 8 to 12 characters (2 to 10 digits in Romania); the national records describe them and their check digits.

doc: The Federal Aviation Administration location identifier (FAA LID) is a three- to five-character alphanumeric code identifying aviation related facilities inside the United States, though some codes are reserved for, and are managed by other entities.

name: Facebook app access token
doc: App access token of the Meta (Facebook) Graph API written as the app ID, a vertical bar and the app secret. Meta allows this form in place of a generated app access token; it contains the app secret and must stay on the server.

name: FCC Product Code (FCC ID)
doc: Identifier of a product assigned by the grantee in an application to the Federal Communications Commission of the United States

name: Finnish association register number

name: Finnish European Health Insurance Card number
doc: Number of the European Health Insurance Card issued in Finland: 20 digits that start with 8024680246.

name: Finnish personal identity code (HETU)
doc: Henkilötunnus, the personal identity code of people registered in Finland. It is the date of birth (DDMMYY), a century sign (+ for the 1800s, - or one of Y, X, W, V, U for the 1900s, A to F for the 2000s), a 3-digit individual number (odd for men, even for women; 900 to 999 for temporary codes) and a check character - the nine-digit number DDMMYYZZZ modulo 31, looked up in 0123456789ABCDEFHJKLMNPRSTUVWXY.

name: Finnish postal code

name: Finnish individual tax number (veronumero)

doc: The Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) (formerly Bloomberg Global Identifier (BBGID)) is an open standard, unique identifier of financial instruments that can be assigned to instruments including common stock, options, derivatives, futures, corporate and government bonds, municipals, currencies, and mortgage products.

name: Finnish identity card
doc: The Finnish identity card is one of two official identity documents in Finland, the other being the Finnish passport.

name: FIPS 6-4 numeric code (US counties)

name: Formal Public Identifier (FPI)
doc: Structured text identifier from SGML (ISO 8879 and ISO/IEC 9070) used in DOCTYPE declarations of SGML, HTML and XML documents. It consists of an owner identifier, a double slash and a text identifier. The owner starts with -// (unregistered), +// (registered) or ISO. The text identifier starts with a public text class such as DTD or ENTITIES, followed by a description and, after another double slash, a language code.

name: Formal title
doc: Title of rank, honour or office written before a person's name, such as Sir, Dame, Lord, Lady, The Honourable or His Excellency. It is more formal than a common title such as Mr or Mrs (civility).

name: Full qualified domain name (FQDN)
doc: A domain name is an identification string that defines a realm of administrative autonomy, authority or control within the Internet.

name: French municipality (commune)
doc: Name of a commune, the smallest administrative unit of France, for example Paris or Mende. Many names occur in more than one department, so a name alone does not identify a commune; its INSEE code (inseecode) does.

name: French department (département)
doc: Name of a department of France, the administrative level between the region and the commune, for example Ain or Corse-du-Sud. France has 101 departments, five of them overseas. The INSEE code of a department is the pattern fr_department_code.

patterns.name: French department code (INSEE)
patterns.doc: Code of a French department in the INSEE Official Geographic Code (COG). Departments in metropolitan France use two characters from 01 to 95, with 2A (Corse-du-Sud) and 2B (Haute-Corse) in place of 20. Overseas departments use three digits, 971 to 974 and 976.

name: French department code (INSEE)
doc: Code of a French department in the INSEE Official Geographic Code (COG). Departments in metropolitan France use two characters from 01 to 95, with 2A (Corse-du-Sud) and 2B (Haute-Corse) in place of 20. Overseas departments use three digits, 971 to 974 and 976.

name: French driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in France. Microsoft Purview looks for twelve digits.

name: French health insurance card number
doc: Number of the French health insurance card (carte Vitale). Microsoft Purview looks for 21 digits in groups of ten, ten and one.

name: French tax identification number (numéro fiscal)
doc: Numéro fiscal de référence, also called NIF or SPI number, the 13-digit number that the French tax administration gives to each person who must report taxes. It starts with 0, 1, 2 or 3 and the last three digits are a check key.

patterns.name: French region code (INSEE)
patterns.doc: Two-digit code of a French region in the INSEE Official Geographic Code (COG). The 18 current codes are 01 to 04 and 06 for the overseas regions and 11, 24, 27, 28, 32, 44, 52, 53, 75, 76, 84, 93 and 94 for the regions of metropolitan France.

name: French region code (INSEE)
doc: Two-digit code of a French region in the INSEE Official Geographic Code (COG). The 18 current codes are 01 to 04 and 06 for the overseas regions and 11, 24, 27, 28, 32, 44, 52, 53, 75, 76, 84, 93 and 94 for the regions of metropolitan France.

name: French social security number (NIR)
doc: French national identification number (numéro d'inscription au répertoire, NIR), known as the social security number. INSEE assigns it to every person born in France. It has 13 characters and a two-digit control key: sex (1 or 2; 7 or 8 for temporary registrations), year and month of birth, department and commune of birth (2A or 2B for Corsica), an order number, and the key. The key is 97 minus the 13-character number modulo 97, with 2A read as 19 and 2B as 18.

Businesses in Monaco receive numbers of the same form (see mc_tva).

name: Opendatasoft geographic point (geo_point_2d)
doc: Geographic point stored in the geo_point_2d field type of the Opendatasoft data platform (now Huwise), which runs many French and other European open data portals. Datasets often keep the default field name geo_point_2d, usually next to a geo_shape field with the full geometry of the record. The point is a latitude and a longitude in decimal degrees. The Explore API v2.1 returns it as a JSON object with lon and lat members. CSV exports write the latitude, a comma and a space, then the longitude, and the legacy Records API v1 returns a [latitude, longitude] array. This latitude-first order is the opposite of GeoJSON.

name: Opendatasoft geographic shape (geo_shape)
doc: Geometry stored in the geo_shape field type of the Opendatasoft data platform (now Huwise), which runs many French and other European open data portals. Datasets often keep the default field name geo_shape, usually next to a geo_point_2d field with a point of the same record. The value is GeoJSON, so positions are longitude first, then latitude. The Explore API v2.1 returns a GeoJSON Feature whose geometry member holds the shape and whose properties member is empty. CSV exports write the bare geometry object instead. One value holds one geometry of any GeoJSON type, such as Point, LineString, Polygon or MultiPolygon.

name: GML object identifier (gml:id)
doc: Value of the gml:id attribute, the handle of an object in a Geography Markup Language (GML) document, such as a feature or a geometry in a WFS response. Its XML Schema type is ID, so the value is an XML NCName (it starts with a letter or an underscore and has no colon or space) and it is unique only within the document that contains it. It serves internal cross-references and is not a persistent identifier; GML carries stable identifiers in gml:identifier instead. GeoServer builds it from the feature type name and a number, as in states.1. GDAL reads the attribute into a string field called gml_id, so tables exported from GML or WFS data with ogr2ogr or QGIS keep it as a column. The regexp covers the NCName characters of the Basic Multilingual Plane.

The check character pair is computed from the other characters with prime weights modulo 1021. In barcodes it is carried by Application Identifier (8013); the element string is the pattern gs1_ai_8013.

The suffix is the local name assigned by that authority. DOIs are handles with prefix 10. The regexp matches handles with a dotted prefix; older handles with a single numeric prefix such as 2381/12345 cannot be told apart from other slash-separated values by their form.

name: Hong Kong identity card number (HKID)
doc: Number of the Hong Kong identity card: one or two letters, six digits and a check character (a digit or A), which is often written in parentheses.

name: Honduran national tax registry number (RTN)
doc: Registro Tributario Nacional (RTN), the tax registration number of taxpayers in Honduras. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as HN-RTN; with that prefix an identifier reads HN-RTN-05019002058739.

name: Honorific prefix (title before a name)
doc: Title written before a person's name to address or refer to the person with courtesy or respect. It groups common titles (civility), formal titles of rank or office, academic and professional titles, and religious titles such as Rev. or Father.

doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Croatia. Microsoft Purview looks for eight digits.

name: Croatian identity card number

name: Croatian personal identification number (OIB)
doc: Osobni identifikacijski broj, the 11-digit identification number of persons and legal entities in Croatia. It holds no personal information and has an ISO 7064 mod 11-10 check digit. With the HR prefix it is the VAT number.

doc: Number of a passport issued by Croatia. Microsoft Purview looks for nine digits.

doc: Color written as hue, saturation and lightness: a hue angle from 0 to 360 degrees and two percentages from 0% to 100%, separated by commas, either bare (0, 100%, 50%) or in the CSS functional notation hsl(0, 100%, 50%). The regexp accepts whole numbers only, without the deg unit, an alpha channel or the space-separated syntax of CSS Color Level 4.

ru.name: Цвет HSL
ru.doc: Цвет, записанный тоном (0–360°), насыщенностью и светлотой в процентах.

name: HTTP Authorization header value
doc: Value of the HTTP Authorization request header: an authentication scheme such as Basic, Bearer, Digest or Negotiate followed by the credentials.

name: HTTP status code
doc: Three-digit code with which an HTTP server reports the result of a request. The first digit gives the class: 1xx informational, 2xx successful, 3xx redirection, 4xx client error and 5xx server error, and all valid codes are between 100 and 599. Examples are 200 (OK), 301 (Moved Permanently), 404 (Not Found) and 500 (Internal Server Error). RFC 9110 defines the codes, and IANA keeps their registry. Web server logs and API monitoring data store them.

ru.name: Код состояния HTTP
ru.doc: Трёхзначный код результата обработки HTTP-запроса от 100 до 599; первая цифра задаёт класс ответа.

name: Hungarian VAT number (ANUM)
doc: Közösségi adószám, the Hungarian EU VAT number: the HU prefix and an 8-digit taxpayer number with a weighted check digit.

name: Hungarian company registration number (cégjegyzékszám)
doc: Cégjegyzékszám, the registration number of a company in the Hungarian company register, which the Information and Electronic Company Registration Service of the Ministry of Justice publishes. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as HU-AFA; with that prefix an identifier reads HU-AFA-01-03-022165.

name: Hungarian county (vármegye)
doc: Name of one of the 19 counties (vármegye) of Hungary, such as Pest, Baranya or Bács-Kiskun. Budapest, the capital, is not part of a county but is often listed with them.

name: Hungarian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Hungary. Microsoft Purview looks for two letters and six digits.

name: Hungarian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Hungary. Microsoft Purview looks for two letters and six or seven digits.

name: Hungarian personal identification number
doc: Hungarian personal identification number (személyi azonosító): 11 digits made of a sex and century digit, the date of birth (YYMMDD), a three-digit serial number and a check digit.

name: Hungarian social security number (TAJ)
doc: Hungarian social security number (TAJ szám) used in health insurance: nine digits, the last of which is a check digit.

EU social security number or equivalent identification

name: Hungarian tax identification number
doc: Tax identification number of a Hungarian private person (adóazonosító jel): ten digits that start with 8 and end with a check digit.

name: IANA Timezone ID
doc: Time zone identifier from the IANA time zone database (tz database), in Area/Location form, for example Europe/London.

name: IATA airline designator (airline code)
doc: IATA airline designators, sometimes called IATA reservation codes, are two-character codes assigned by the International Air Transport Association (IATA) to the worlds airlines.

name: IATA Airport code
doc: An IATA airport code, also known as an IATA location identifier, IATA station code, or simply a location identifier, is a three-letter geocode designating many airports and metropolitan areas around the world, defined by the International Air Transport Association (IATA)

name: IATI-assigned organisation identifier
doc: Identifier that the IATI Secretariat generates for an organisation that has no identifier in a recognised registration agency, so that it can be named in IATI data. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as XI-IATI; with that prefix an identifier reads XI-IATI-IADB.

name: International Bank Account Number
doc: The International Bank Account Number (IBAN) is an internationally agreed system of identifying bank accounts across national borders to facilitate the communication and processing of cross border transactions with a reduced risk of transcription errors. An IBAN uniquely identifies the account of a customer at a financial institution.

name: ICAO Airline code
doc: The ICAO airline designator is a code assigned by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) to aircraft operating agencies, aeronautical authorities, and services related to international aviation, each of which is allocated both a three-letter designator and a telephony designator.

name: ICAO Airport code
doc: The ICAO airport code or location indicator is a four-letter code designating aerodromes around the world. These codes, as defined by the International Civil Aviation Organization and published in ICAO Document 7910: Location Indicators, are used by air traffic control and airline operations such as flight planning.

name: Integrated Circuit Card Identifier (ICCID)
doc: The Integrated Circuit Card Identifier (ICCID) is a unique identifier for SIM cards. It is defined by ITU-T E.118 standard and consists of 19-20 digits with a Luhn check digit.

name: Identifier in the ICD catalogue codes for diseases - Version 10 (ICD-10)
doc: ICD-10 is the 10th revision of the International Statistical Classification of Diseases and Related Health Problems (ICD), a medical classification list by the World Health Organization (WHO).

ru.name: МКБ-10
ru.doc: Международная статистическая классификация болезней и проблем, связанных со здоровьем, Десятого пересмотра (МКБ-10) — версия классификатора МКБ, разработанная в 1989 году, принятая ВОЗ в 1990 году

name: ICD-10-Code
doc: DE datatype for 'ICD-10 diagnosis code by field name' (icd10code) from rules in context 'medical'. Covers standard ICD-10 and ICD-10-GM codes used in Germany.

name: ICD-9 code
doc: Code of the Ninth Revision of the International Classification of Diseases (ICD-9) of the World Health Organization, which ICD-10 later replaced. A code is three digits for a category of diseases, with up to two decimal digits for a subcategory. Supplementary codes start with V (factors that influence health status and contact with health services) or E (external causes of injury and poisoning). ICD-9-CM, the clinical modification used in the United States until October 2015, adds a volume of procedure codes, which the regexp does not cover.

examples.description: Contact with or exposure to communicable diseases

ru.name: Код МКБ-9

name: International Chemical Safety Card (ICSC) number
doc: Four-digit, zero-padded number of an International Chemical Safety Card. The cards summarize the hazards of a chemical and the protective measures for it; the International Labour Organization and the World Health Organization publish them.

ru.name: Номер международной карты химической безопасности (ICSC)

name: Irish county
doc: Name of a traditional county of Ireland, such as Dublin, Cork or Galway, in English or Irish (Corcaigh). The island has 32 traditional counties: 26 in the Republic of Ireland and six in Northern Ireland.

name: Irish company number (CRO)
doc: Number of a company in the register of the Companies Registration Office (CRO) of Ireland. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as IE-CRO; with that prefix an identifier reads IE-CRO-123260.

name: Irish driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Ireland. Microsoft Purview looks for six digits and four letters.

name: Irish passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Ireland. Microsoft Purview looks for two letters or digits and seven digits.

name: Irish Personal Public Service number (PPS)
doc: Personal Public Service Number, the identifier for social welfare, public services and tax in Ireland. It has seven digits and a check letter, sometimes followed by a second letter (A or B for individuals, H for non-individuals such as companies or trusts).

name: Irish province
doc: Name of one of the four historic provinces of Ireland: Connacht, Leinster, Munster or Ulster. They have no administrative role today but are used in statistics and sport.

name: Irish VAT number
doc: VAT registration number in Ireland. It has eight or nine characters: seven digits and one or two letters. An older form has a letter or symbol in the second position.

name: Israeli non-profit association number (amuta)
doc: Number of a non-profit association (amuta) in the register of associations (Rasham Ha'amutot) of Israel. These numbers start with 58. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as IL-RA; with that prefix an identifier reads IL-RA-580197770.

name: Israeli bank account number
doc: Number of a bank account held in Israel. Microsoft Purview looks for 13 digits, or two, three and eight digits separated by hyphens.

name: Israeli company number
doc: Mispar ḥevra (מספר חברה, short ח.פ.), the 9-digit registration number of a corporation in Israel. Companies start with 5, and the first two digits give the type of corporation. The last digit is a Luhn check digit.

name: Israeli identity number (Mispar Zehut)
doc: Mispar Zehut (מספר זהות), the 9-digit identity number given to Israeli citizens at birth. The last digit is a Luhn check digit; leading zeros are sometimes left out.

name: Isle of Man registered charity number
doc: Number of a charity in the Isle of Man Index of Registered Charities. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as IM-GR; with that prefix an identifier reads IM-GR-1184.

name: Isle of Man company number
doc: Number of a company in the Isle of Man Companies Registry. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as IM-CR; with that prefix an identifier reads IM-CR-005095V.

name: International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI)
doc: The International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI) is a numeric identifier, usually unique for 3GPP and iDEN mobile phones, as well as some satellite phones.

name: IMO ship Number
doc: The International Maritime Organization (IMO) number is a unique identifier for ships, registered ship owners and management companies.

name: imphash

name: The international mobile subscriber identity (IMSI)
doc: The international mobile subscriber identity (IMSI) is a number that uniquely identifies every user of a cellular network.

name: Indian corporate identification number (CIN)
doc: Corporate Identification Number (CIN), the 21-character number that the Ministry of Corporate Affairs of India gives to companies. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as IN-MCA; with that prefix an identifier reads IN-MCA-L24111UR1986PLC015895.

name: Indian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in India. Microsoft Purview looks for a two-letter state code, a two-digit office code, the four-digit year of issue and seven digits, optionally separated by spaces or hyphens.

name: Indian voter ID card number (EPIC)
doc: Number of the Indian Electors Photo Identity Card (voter ID) issued by the Election Commission of India: three letters and seven digits.

name: Indian FCRA registration number
doc: Registration number of an association under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act, given by the Ministry of Home Affairs of India. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as IN-MHA; with that prefix an identifier reads IN-MHA-104860017.

name: Indian GST identification number (GSTIN)
doc: Goods and Services Tax identification number of India, 15 characters: a two-digit state code, the holder's PAN, an entity number, the letter Z and a check character.

name: Indian postal code (PIN code)
doc: Postal Index Number (PIN code) in India: six digits, sometimes with a space after the third. The first digit is a postal zone: 1 to 8 for regions of India, 9 for the Army Postal Service.

name: In-Reply-To (Email Header)
doc: In-Reply-To is an email header field that contains the Message-ID of the message to which this message is a reply, as defined in RFC 5322.

name: Indian Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN)
doc: Ten-character number that the Indian Income Tax Department issues to persons and organizations that must deduct or collect tax at source. It must be quoted on TDS and TCS returns, payments and certificates. It has four letters, five digits and a letter. The first three letters stand for the city or state of issue and the fourth is the first letter of the deductor's name.

name: International Chemical Identifier (InChl)
doc: International Chemical Identifier (InChI): a textual identifier for chemical substances defined by IUPAC. It starts with 'InChI='.

name: INN (Russian tax identifier)
doc: Russian organization/person tax identification number (INN) is unique for each person and organization.

name: INSEE code
doc: The INSEE code is a numerical indexing code used by the French National Institute for Statistics and Economic Studies (INSEE) to identify various entities, including communes and départements.

doc: Registration number of a company at the Registrar of Companies of the Ministry of Trade of Iraq. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as IQ-MOT; with that prefix an identifier reads IQ-MOT-31813-2.

name: Iraqi NGO registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation at the NGO Directorate of Iraq. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as IQ-NGO; with that prefix an identifier reads IQ-NGO-1Z2364.

name: Icelandic identity number (kennitala)
doc: Kennitala, the 10-digit identity code of individuals and organisations in Iceland. It starts with a date (DDMMYY; organisations add 40 to the day), then two digits, a check digit and a century digit (9 for the 1900s, 0 for the 2000s). A hyphen usually follows the sixth digit.

name: International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN)
doc: ISO 15706 identifier of audiovisual works, such as films and episodes. It is hexadecimal: a 12-digit root and a 4-digit episode or part, an optional check character, then optionally an 8-digit version and a second check character. The check characters use ISO 7064 mod 37,36.

doc: ISBN by field name identifier

name: International Standard Book Number 10-digits (ISBN10)
doc: 10-digit International Standard Book Number, used for books published before 2007. The last character is a check digit (0-9 or X).

name: International Standard Book Number 13-digits (ISBN13)
doc: 13-digit International Standard Book Number, used since 2007. It starts with the prefix 978 or 979.

name: ISIC rev 4 class code
doc: Code of industry by ISIC (International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities)

name: International Standard Identifier for Libraries (ISIL)
doc: ISO 15511 identifier of libraries, archives, museums and related organisations. It has up to 15 characters: a prefix (a 2-letter country code or a non-national agency prefix), a hyphen and an identifier given by that agency. Letters, digits, hyphens, colons and slashes are used.

name: International Securities Identification Number
doc: An International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) uniquely identifies a security. Its structure is defined in ISO 6166. The ISIN code is a 12-character alphanumeric code that serves for uniform identification of a security through normalization of the assigned National Number, where one exists, at trading and settlement.

name: International Standard Music Number (ISMN)
doc: ISO 10957 identifier of notated (printed) music. The current form has 13 digits starting with 979-0; the older 10-character form starts with M. The last digit is a check digit.
