name: International Standard Name Identifier
doc: The International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI) is an identifier system for uniquely identifying the public identities of contributors to media content such as books, television programmes, and newspaper articles. Such an identifier consists of 16 digits. It can optionally be displayed as divided into four blocks.

name: ISO 3166-2:MX (3-letters code)
doc: ISO 3166-2:MX 3-letters alphanumeric codes used to identify Mexican states.

name: identifier for a country subdivision per ISO 3166-2
doc: identifier for a country subdivision per ISO 3166-2 (include country code)

name: ISO 639-1 language code (two letters)
doc: Two-letter code of a language from ISO 639-1, such as en (English), de (German) or ja (Japanese). About 180 languages have such a code. It is written in lowercase, but data sets often use uppercase.

name: ISO 639-2 language code (three letters)
doc: Three-letter code of a language from ISO 639-2, such as eng (English) or rus (Russian). About twenty languages have two codes: a bibliographic one based on the English name (ger, fre) and a terminology one based on the native name (deu, fra).

name: ISO 6523 organization identifier
doc: An organization identifier as defined in ISO 6523(-1)

name: ISO 6709 geopoint
doc: Geographic point as string by ISO 6709, ISO 6709, Standard representation of geographic point location by coordinates, is the international standard for representation of latitude, longitude and altitude for geographic point locations.

name: Duration
doc: The amount of intervening time in a time interval and are represented by the format P[n]Y[n]M[n]DT[n]H[n]M[n]S or P[n]W as shown on the aside

examples.description: Three years, six months, four days, twelve hours, thirty minutes, and five seconds

name: International Standard Recording Code (ISRC)
doc: The International Standard Recording Code (ISRC) is an international standard code for uniquely identifying sound recordings and music video recordings. The code was developed by the recording industry and is officially designated as the ISO 3901 standard. An ISRC identifies a particular recording, not the work (composition and lyrical content) itself. Therefore, different recordings, edits, and remixes of the same work should have different ISRCs.

name: International Standard Serial Number (ISSN)
doc: The International Standard Serial Number (ISSN) is an eight-digit serial number used to uniquely identify a serial publication, such as a magazine. The ISSN is especially helpful in distinguishing between serials with the same title. ISSNs are used in ordering, cataloging, interlibrary loans, and other practices in connection with serial literature.

name: International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)
doc: ISO 15707 identifier of a musical work as a composition, apart from its recordings (which have ISRC codes) and editions. It is the letter T, a nine-digit work number and a check digit, usually printed as T-123.456.789-C; the dots and hyphens are optional. Collecting societies issue the numbers in sequence under CISAC, the registration authority, and the number says nothing about the work. The check digit is a weighted sum of the digits modulo 10, which the registry does not verify.

name: Italian medicine authorisation code (AIC)
doc: Codice AIC (autorizzazione all'immissione in commercio), the code that the Italian Medicines Agency (AIFA) gives to each medicine pack authorised for sale in Italy. It has nine digits including a check digit, or six characters in its base-32 form.

name: Italian tax code (codice fiscale)
doc: Codice fiscale, the tax code of people in Italy, issued by the Agenzia delle Entrate: 16 characters derived from the surname, the first name, the date of birth and sex (40 is added to the day for women), and the Belfiore code of the place of birth, with a check letter at the end. When two people would get the same code, digits are replaced by letters (omocodia). Legal entities have an 11-digit code that equals their VAT number (it_iva).

name: Italian municipality (comune)
doc: Name of a comune, the basic municipality of Italy, such as Roma, Bergamo or Abano Terme. Italy has about 7,900 comuni.

name: Italian unique office code (codice univoco ufficio)
doc: Codice univoco ufficio, the 6-character code of an office (organisational unit) of the Italian public administration in the IPA index. It is used, for example, to address electronic invoices to public bodies. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as IT-CUUO; with that prefix an identifier reads IT-CUUO-7GEM3B.

name: Italian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Italy. Microsoft Purview looks for ten letters and digits: a letter, a letter or digit, seven letters or digits and a final letter, optionally separated by spaces or hyphens.

name: Italian VAT number (partita IVA)
doc: Partita IVA, the 11-digit VAT number in Italy: seven digits that identify the taxpayer, a 3-digit tax office code (mostly the province code; 888 and 999 are used for special regimes and for non-residents) and a Luhn check digit. In the EU form it has the IT prefix. For companies the 11 digits are also the fiscal code.

name: Italian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Italy. Microsoft Purview looks for two letters or digits and seven digits.

name: Italian postal code (CAP)
doc: Italian postal code (CAP, codice di avviamento postale): five digits. San Marino and Vatican City also use codes from this system.

name: Italian province
doc: Name of a province or metropolitan city of Italy, the level between the region and the comune, such as Milano, Napoli or Bolzano. Each has a two-letter abbreviation, the pattern it_province_code.

patterns.name: Italian province abbreviation (sigla)
patterns.doc: Two-letter abbreviation (sigla) of an Italian province or metropolitan city, such as MI (Milano), RM (Roma) or NA (Napoli). It is written in addresses after the name of the comune.

name: Italian province abbreviation (sigla)
doc: Two-letter abbreviation (sigla) of an Italian province or metropolitan city, such as MI (Milano), RM (Roma) or NA (Napoli). It is written in addresses after the name of the comune.

name: Italian region
doc: Name of one of the 20 regions of Italy, such as Lombardia, Lazio or Sicilia, in Italian or English (Lombardy, Sicily). Five of them have special autonomy.

name: Identification of an Individual Trade Item Piece (ITIP)
doc: GS1 identifier of one piece of a trade item that is delivered in several pieces, such as a piece of furniture packed in three boxes. Eighteen digits: the 14-digit GTIN of the trade item, the piece number and the total number of pieces, two digits each. Neither number is 00, and the piece number does not exceed the total. Application Identifier (8006) carries it, and (8026) carries the ITIP of pieces contained in a logistic unit; the element strings are the patterns gs1_ai_8006 and gs1_ai_8026.

patterns.name: Individual trade item piece (ITIP) (GS1 AI 8006)
patterns.doc: GS1 element string of Application Identifier (8006): '8006' followed by an 18-digit ITIP: a GTIN, the piece number and the total. GS1 format N4+N14+N2+N2. In the human-readable text under a barcode it is written as (8006) and the value.

patterns.name: ITIP of pieces contained in a logistic unit (GS1 AI 8026)
patterns.doc: GS1 element string of Application Identifier (8026): '8026' followed by the 18-digit ITIP of the trade item pieces contained in a logistic unit. GS1 format N4+N14+N2+N2. It is used together with AI (37), the count of the contained items. In the human-readable text under a barcode it is written as (8026) and the value.

name: Jersey registered charity number
doc: Number of a charity in the Jersey Charity Register. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as JE-JCR; with that prefix an identifier reads JE-JCR-345.

name: Jersey Financial Services Commission registry number
doc: Number of a company or other entity in the registry of the Jersey Financial Services Commission (JFSC). The number alone is not unique: ORG-ID.guide adds the registry type, such as RC_ for companies. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as JE-FSC; with that prefix an identifier reads JE-FSC-RC_119821.

name: JFrog Artifactory API key
doc: Deprecated API key of JFrog Artifactory: the prefix AKCp followed by 69 letters and digits (the format that the gitleaks secret scanner checks). JFrog replaced API keys with reference and access tokens, but old keys still appear in configuration files.

name: JFrog reference token
doc: Short token of the JFrog Platform (Artifactory) that refers to a full JWT access token. It has 64 characters: the prefix cmVmd followed by 59 letters and digits. JFrog introduced it to replace API keys.

name: Jordanian association registration number
doc: Number of an association in the Register of Associations of Jordan. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as JO-MSD; with that prefix an identifier reads JO-MSD-2013011100066.

name: Jordanian company national number
doc: National number of a company at the Companies Control Department of Jordan. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as JO-CCD; with that prefix an identifier reads JO-CCD-200105534.

name: Japanese bank account number
doc: Number of a bank account held in Japan. Microsoft Purview looks for seven or eight digits; the four-digit bank code and three-digit branch code are written separately.

name: Japanese corporate number (hōjin bangō)
doc: 法人番号 (hōjin bangō), the 13-digit Corporate Number that the National Tax Agency gives to corporations, government bodies and other organisations in Japan. The first digit is a check digit and is never 0.

name: Japanese driver's license number
doc: Twelve-digit number of a Japanese driver's license. The first two digits identify the prefectural public safety commission that first issued the license, the next two are the last two digits of the year it was first obtained, then come a six-digit serial number, a check digit and a last digit that counts reissues.

examples.description: separators are not part of the number

name: Japanese passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Japan - two letters followed by seven digits. The first letter shows the passport type (M for a five-year passport, T for a ten-year one).

name: Japanese basic pension number
doc: Ten-digit number that identifies a person across all Japanese public pension schemes. It was introduced in January 1997 and stays the same for life. It is written as a four-digit code and a six-digit serial number, usually with a hyphen between them. It is different from the twelve-digit My Number (mynumber).

name: Japanese postal code
doc: Postal code (郵便番号) in Japan: seven digits, written as three digits, a hyphen and four digits, often after the 〒 mark.

name: Japanese prefecture code (JIS X 0401)
doc: Two-digit code of a Japanese prefecture from JIS X 0401, from 01 (Hokkaido) to 47 (Okinawa), for example 13 for Tokyo. ISO 3166-2:JP uses the same number after JP-.

name: Japanese region
doc: Name of one of the eight traditional regions of Japan that group the prefectures: Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kansai (Kinki), Chugoku, Shikoku and Kyushu with Okinawa. It is written in Japanese, with or without 地方 (region), or in English.

name: Japanese residence card number
doc: Number of the residence card (在留カード) issued to mid- to long-term foreign residents of Japan: two letters, eight digits and two letters.

name: Japanese resident registration number
doc: Eleven-digit number that Microsoft Purview detects as the Japanese resident registration number; the resident record code (住民票コード) of the Basic Resident Register has 11 digits.

name: JSON Web Token (JWT)
doc: Compact JSON Web Token (RFC 7519) signed with JWS: three Base64url parts (header, claims and signature) separated by dots. The header and the claims are JSON objects, so both parts start with ey. Used as bearer access tokens and ID tokens; the encrypted JWE form has five parts and is not covered.

name: Russian budget classification code (KBK)
doc: Russian budget classification code KBK (kod byudzhetnoy klassifikacii) identifiers certain budget allocation of the federal or regional budget

ru.name: Код бюджетной классификации (КБК)
ru.doc: Код бюджетной классификации (КБК) используется в бюджетной системе РФ для идентификации конкретной строки расхода федерального или регионального государственного бюджета.

name: Kenyan KRA PIN
doc: Personal Identification Number (PIN) that the Kenya Revenue Authority gives to taxpayers, including companies and other organisations. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as KE-KRA; with that prefix an identifier reads KE-KRA-P00000000150Q.

name: Kenyan NGO registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation at the NGOs Co-ordination Board of Kenya. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as KE-NCB; with that prefix an identifier reads KE-NCB-218051120898201.

name: Keccak-256 hash
doc: Digest of the original Keccak-256 hash function (256 bits) as used by Ethereum. It differs from the standardized SHA3-256, which uses different padding. It is written as 64 hexadecimal digits. SHA-256, Keccak-256 and BLAKE2b-256 digests have the same length, so the value alone does not tell them apart: use the field name or context.

examples.description: Keccak-256 hash of the empty string
one hex digit short (63 instead of 64)

name: Keccak-512 hash
doc: Digest of the original Keccak-512 hash function (512 bits). It differs from the standardized SHA3-512, which uses different padding. It is written as 128 hexadecimal digits. SHA-512, Keccak-512 and BLAKE2b-512 digests have the same length, so the value alone does not tell them apart: use the field name or context.

examples.description: Keccak-512 hash of the empty string
one hex digit short (127 instead of 128)

name: Keyword
doc: A short word or phrase that describes the topic of a resource, such as a document, dataset or web page, and is used to find and group such resources. Keywords can be free-form tags or terms from a controlled vocabulary. One field often holds several keywords separated by commas or semicolons. Semantic MediaWiki has a Keyword datatype for these values; it limits their length and matches them case- and diacritic-insensitively.

examples.description: topic keyword of an environmental dataset
topic keyword of a data portal page

name: Kyrgyz taxpayer identification number (INN)
doc: ИНН, the taxpayer identification number of a legal entity or branch, as shown in the register of legal entities of the Ministry of Justice of Kyrgyzstan. ORG-ID.guide lists it under KG-TIN and KG-INN; with that prefix an identifier reads KG-TIN-02507199510010.

name: Kyrgyz OKPO code
doc: OKPO code, the statistical code of an enterprise or organisation in Kyrgyzstan, as shown in the register of legal entities. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as KG-OKPO; with that prefix an identifier reads KG-OKPO-29693656.

name: Kyrgyz legal entity registration number
doc: Registration number (Рег. №) of a legal entity or branch in the register of legal entities of the Ministry of Justice of Kyrgyzstan. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as KG-ID; with that prefix an identifier reads KG-ID-48206-3303-ООО.

name: Cambodian NGO registration number
doc: Registration number of a national non-governmental organisation at the Ministry of Interior of Cambodia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as KH-NNGO; with that prefix an identifier reads KH-NNGO-502.

name: KLADR code (Russian)
doc: Russian unique codes assigned by Government Tax Service for every administrative address in Russian federation. Replaces by FIAS government system

ru.name: Код КЛАДР
ru.doc: КЛАДР — ведомственный классификатор ФНС России, созданный для распределения территорий между налоговыми инспекциями и автоматизированной рассылки корреспонденции. Заменен системой ФИАС

doc: Russian Public Administration Sector Classification Code (KOSGU) used in Russian budget planning and procurement

doc: NL datatype for 'KvK-nummer op veldnaam' (kvk) from rules in context 'companies'. The KvK-nummer (Kamer van Koophandel nummer) is a unique 8-digit registration number assigned to businesses and organizations in the Netherlands by the Chamber of Commerce (Kamer van Koophandel). Every business entity registered in the Netherlands receives a KvK number, which is used for official identification and registration purposes. The number consists of exactly 8 digits, sometimes with leading zeros.

name: Russian budget expense type code (KVR)
doc: Code of the Russian budget expense type (код вида расходов, КВР), the part of the budget classification that describes the kind of expense. Used in budget planning and public procurement.

name: Kazakh business identification number (BIN)
doc: Бизнес-идентификационный номер (BIN), the 12-digit identification number of a legal entity or branch in Kazakhstan. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as KZ-BIN; with that prefix an identifier reads KZ-BIN-950440001673.

name: Laboratory test name
doc: Name of a laboratory or blood test, for example complete blood count or HbA1c.

name: Language
doc: Human language written as a name, such as English, Deutsch or allemand (German in French), or as a code. Codes have their own patterns: iso639_1 (two letters) and iso639_2 (three letters). A language tag with region or script subtags, such as en-GB, is the datatype languagetag.

patterns.name: ISO 639-1 language code (two letters)
patterns.doc: Two-letter code of a language from ISO 639-1, such as en (English), de (German) or ja (Japanese). About 180 languages have such a code. It is written in lowercase, but data sets often use uppercase.

patterns.name: ISO 639-2 language code (three letters)
patterns.doc: Three-letter code of a language from ISO 639-2, such as eng (English) or rus (Russian). About twenty languages have two codes: a bibliographic one based on the English name (ger, fre) and a terminology one based on the native name (deu, fra).

name: IETF language tag
doc: An IETF BCP 47 language tag is a standardized code or tag that is used to identify human languages in the Internet. The tag structure has been standardized by the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) in Best Current Practice (BCP) 47; the subtags are maintained by the IANA Language Subtag Registry.

ru.name: Языковой код IETF
ru.doc: Языковой код/тэг по стандарту IETF BCP 47 идентифицирующий конкретный человеческий язык, стиль написания и тд.

name: Indian last name by known name
doc: Indian last name by known name identifier

name: latitude
doc: In geography, latitude is a geographic coordinate that specifies the north–south position of a point on the Earths surface. Latitude is an angle (defined below) which ranges from 0° at the Equator to 90° (North or South) at the poles.

name: Lebanese commercial register number
doc: Number of a company in the Commercial Register of the Ministry of Justice of Lebanon. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LB-CR; with that prefix an identifier reads LB-CR-77621.

name: Library of Congress Classification (LCC) number
doc: Class number or call number in the Library of Congress Classification, the subject classification of the US Library of Congress, which most research and academic libraries in the United States use to shelve books. It starts with one to three letters for the class and subclass, such as QA for mathematics or TK for electrical engineering, followed by a number with an optional decimal part. A call number adds Cutter numbers, such as .P98, and often a year. The regexp is adapted from the Wikidata format of property P1149 and requires a class number.

examples.description: Class number with a Cutter number
Class number with a decimal part

ru.name: Индекс Классификации Библиотеки Конгресса (LCC)
ru.doc: Классификационный индекс или шифр хранения по Классификации Библиотеки Конгресса США.

name: Library of Congress Control Number (LCCN)
doc: Serial number of a catalog record of the US Library of Congress, used since 1898. It is made of a year and a six-digit serial number with leading zeros. The year has two digits for 1898 to 2000 and four digits from 2001. A hyphen between year and serial number is optional. Some numbers start with a short alphabetic prefix such as n, sh or sn. The LCCN is not related to the Library of Congress Classification.

examples.description: Name authority: Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals
The serial number must have six digits

name: Legal document type by known name
doc: Legal document type by known name identifier

name: Legislation name
doc: A legal document such as an act, decree, bill, etc. (enforceable or not) or a component of a legal act (like an article).

ru.name: Название нормативного документа
ru.doc: Название нормативного документа

name: Legislation type
doc: The type of the legislation. Examples of values are "law", "act", "directive", "decree", "regulation", "statutory instrument", "loi organique", "reglement grand-ducal", etc., depending on the country.

ru.name: Тип нормативного документа
ru.doc: Тип нормативного документа

name: Legal Entity Identifier
doc: The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is a unique global identifier for legal entities participating in financial transactions. Also known as an LEI code or LEI number, its purpose is to help identify legal entities on a globally accessible database. Legal entities are organisations such as companies or government entities that participate in financial transactions. An individual person may not obtain an LEI.

name: Liechtenstein personal identification number (PEID)
doc: Personenidentifikationsnummer, a numeric code of up to 12 digits that identifies individuals and entities in Liechtenstein, used as the tax identification number.

examples.description: Synthetic number in the documented format
Synthetic number in the documented format

name: License number by known name
doc: License number by known name identifier

name: Sri Lankan company registration number
doc: Registration number of a company at the Department of the Registrar of Companies of Sri Lanka. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LK-DRC; with that prefix an identifier reads LK-DRC-GA139.

name: Sri Lankan NGO registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation at the National Secretariat for Non-Governmental Organisations of Sri Lanka. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LK-NGO; with that prefix an identifier reads LK-NGO-80505.

name: Longitude
doc: Longitude is a geographic coordinate that specifies the east–west position of a point on the Earths surface, or the surface of a celestial body. It is an angular measurement, usually expressed in degrees and denoted by the Greek letter lambda (λ)

name: Customer loyalty number by known name
doc: Customer loyalty number by known name identifier

name: Liberian NGO registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation at the Ministry of Finance and Development Planning of Liberia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LR-MFDPNGO; with that prefix an identifier reads LR-MFDPNGO-0961.

name: Lesotho higher education institution registration number
doc: Registration number of a higher education institution in Lesotho. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LS-HEI; with that prefix an identifier reads LS-HEI-HEI-CRL-2025CNT-3182004.

name: Lesotho society registration number
doc: Registration number of a society (a non-profit organisation) in Lesotho. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LS-SRN; with that prefix an identifier reads LS-SRN-88-6.

name: Life Science Identifier (LSID)
doc: Identifier for a piece of life-science data, written in URN form as urn:lsid:<authority>:<namespace>:<object id>, optionally followed by :<version>. The authority is usually the domain name of the issuing service. The lsid namespace was never registered with IANA. LSIDs are still used by biodiversity catalogues such as ZooBank to identify taxonomic names and publications.

name: Lithuanian personal code (asmens kodas)
doc: Asmens kodas, the 11-digit personal code in Lithuania. The first digit gives the sex and the century of birth, the next six the date of birth (YYMMDD), then come a 3-digit serial number and a check digit.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: Lithuanian legal entity code (juridinio asmens kodas)
doc: Juridinio asmens kodas, the 9-digit code of a legal entity in the Register of Legal Entities of Lithuania (Registrų centras). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LT-RC; with that prefix an identifier reads LT-RC-111484678.

name: Lithuanian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Lithuania. Microsoft Purview looks for eight digits.

name: Lithuanian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Lithuania. Microsoft Purview looks for eight letters or digits.

name: Lithuanian VAT number (PVM)
doc: PVM mokėtojo kodas, the VAT code in Lithuania: nine digits for legal entities or twelve digits for temporarily registered taxpayers, with a check digit.

name: Luxembourg driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Luxembourg. Microsoft Purview looks for six digits.

name: Luxembourg national identification number
doc: National identification number (matricule) of a natural person in Luxembourg: 13 digits, of which the last two are check digits.

name: Luxembourg national identification number of a legal entity
doc: National identification number of a legal entity (non-natural person) in Luxembourg, also used as its tax number: 11 digits that end with a check digit.

name: Luxembourg passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Luxembourg. Microsoft Purview looks for seven or eight letters or digits.

name: Luxembourg trade and companies register number (RCS)
doc: Number of a company in the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (Registre de commerce et des sociétés, RCS): a letter followed by digits. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LU-RCS; with that prefix an identifier reads LU-RCS-B247312.

name: Luxembourg VAT number
doc: Numéro d'identification à la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, the 8-digit VAT number in Luxembourg. The last two digits are check digits.

name: Latvian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Latvia. Microsoft Purview looks for three letters and six digits.

name: Latvian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Latvia. Microsoft Purview looks for two letters or digits and seven digits.

name: Latvian personal code
doc: Latvian personal code (personas kods), 11 digits. Codes issued before July 2017 start with the date of birth (DDMMYY), followed by a hyphen, a century digit and four digits. Newer codes start with 32 and carry no date of birth.

name: Latvian VAT number (PVN)
doc: PVN reģistrācijas numurs, the 11-digit VAT number in Latvia. For legal entities the first digit is greater than 3; for natural persons it is the personal code (personas kods), which starts with the date of birth (DDMMYY) or, for newer codes, with 32.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: Latvian registration number
doc: Reģistrācijas numurs, the 11-digit registration number of a company in the Register of Enterprises of the Republic of Latvia. With the LV prefix it is the VAT number (lv_pvn). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LV-RE; with that prefix an identifier reads LV-RE-40008124830.

name: MAC address (Media Access Control)
doc: A media access control address (MAC address) is a unique identifier assigned to a network interface controller (NIC) for use as a network address in communications within a network segment.

name: Magnet URI (BitTorrent)
doc: A magnet link is a type of hyperlink that uses the magnet: URI scheme to reference a resource by its content hash (using a hash function such as SHA-1), rather than by its location. Magnet links are commonly used in BitTorrent and other peer-to-peer file sharing protocols to identify files by their content hash rather than by a specific server location.

examples.description: Basic magnet link with info hash and display name
Minimal magnet link with only info hash

name: Mailchimp API key
doc: API key of the Mailchimp Marketing API: 32 hexadecimal digits, a hyphen and the data center of the account (for example us6), which is also the subdomain of the API endpoint.

name: Marital status
doc: Civil status of a person with respect to marriage: single, married, divorced, widowed, separated or in a civil partnership. Data sets also use one-letter codes such as S, M, D and W.

name: Monaco trade and industry register number (RCI)
doc: Number of a business in the Trade and Industry Register (Répertoire du commerce et de l'industrie, RCI) of Monaco. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MC-RCI; with that prefix an identifier reads MC-RCI-00S03773.

name: Monaco VAT number
doc: VAT number (numéro de TVA) of businesses in Monaco, which belongs to the French VAT territory. It has the French format, FR followed by a 2-character key and nine digits, but the nine digits start with 000 instead of being a French SIREN.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: MD5 hash
doc: Digest of the MD5 hash function (128 bits), often used as a checksum of a file or as a record fingerprint. MD5 is not collision-resistant and must not be used for security. It is written as 32 hexadecimal digits.

examples.description: MD5 hash of the empty string
one hex digit short (31 instead of 32)

name: MD5 hash
doc: Digest of the MD5 hash function (128 bits), often used as a checksum of a file or as a record fingerprint. MD5 is not collision-resistant and must not be used for security. It is written as 32 hexadecimal digits.

examples.description: MD5 hash of the empty string
one hex digit short (31 instead of 32)

name: Moldovan state identification number (IDNO)
doc: IDNO (numărul de identificare de stat), the 13-digit identifier of legal entities in Moldova. It holds a registry digit, three digits for the year the code was assigned, an identifier and a check digit.

name: Montenegrin IBAN
doc: International Bank Account Number of a bank account in Montenegro. It has 22 characters: ME, two IBAN check digits, a 3-digit bank code, a 13-digit account number and two national check digits.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit
The first example in its printed form

name: Montenegrin tax identification number (PIB)
doc: Poreski identifikacioni broj (PIB), the tax identification number of companies and other organisations in Montenegro. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ME-PIB; with that prefix an identifier reads ME-PIB-04252361.

name: Medical condition name
doc: Name of a disease, disorder, injury or impairment, for example tuberculosis or type 2 diabetes. Linked to a person, it is health data.

purview: Impairments Listed In The U.S. Disability Evaluation Under Social Security

name: Medical specialty
doc: Branch of medical practice, for example cardiology or pediatrics.

name: Australian Medicare number by known name
doc: Australian Medicare number by known name identifier

name: Medication brand name
doc: Proprietary (trade) name under which a medicine is sold.

name: Medication class
doc: Group of medicines with a similar action or use, for example antibiotics or beta blockers.

name: Medication generic name
doc: Non-proprietary (generic) name of a medicine or its active ingredient, such as an International Nonproprietary Name (INN).

name: Mobile Equipment Identifier (MEID)
doc: 56-bit identifier of CDMA mobile devices. It is written as 14 hexadecimal characters or as an 18-digit decimal number, either of them optionally followed by a check character.

examples.description: Synthetic number in the documented format
Synthetic number in the documented format

name: Message-ID (Email Message Identifier)
doc: Message-ID is a unique identifier for an email message, as defined in RFC 5322. It is used to identify individual messages in email systems and is typically in the format <unique-string@domain>.

name: Malagasy tax identification number (NIF)
doc: Numéro d'identification fiscale (NIF) that the Directorate General of Taxes of Madagascar gives to taxpayers. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MG-NIF; with that prefix an identifier reads MG-NIF-4001257310.

name: Military Grid Reference System (MGRS) coordinate
doc: Position written in the Military Grid Reference System of NATO, which is based on UTM. It is a grid zone designator (a UTM zone number from 1 to 60 and a latitude band letter from C to X without I and O), a two-letter identifier of a 100 km square, and an even number of digits, up to ten, that give the easting and then the northing within the square: four digits locate a 1 km square, ten digits a 1 m square. Spaces between the parts are optional. The regexp does not cover the polar regions, which use the UPS form with bands A, B, Y and Z.

examples.description: 10 m precision, example from the Wikipedia article
Easting and northing of different lengths

ru.name: Координата MGRS
ru.doc: Положение в военной системе координатной сетки НАТО (MGRS): зона UTM, квадрат 100 км и чётное число цифр восточного и северного смещения.

name: Market Identifier Code (ISO 10383)
doc: This International Standard specifies a universal method of identifying exchanges, trading platforms, regulated or non-regulated markets and trade reporting facilities as sources of prices and related information in order to facilitate automated processing

examples.description: Bulgarian Stock Exchange - SME Growth Market Beam

name: Military name suffix
doc: Abbreviation of a military service written after a person's name, for example USN or USMC. In the United States military it helps to compare seniority between services and can show reserve status.

name: Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME)
doc: Mime type of the file/content. Used to identify contents of the stream or file. The MIME standard is specified in a series of requests for comments: RFC 2045, RFC 2046, RFC 2047, RFC 4288, RFC 4289 and RFC 2049.

name: North Macedonian entity registration number (EMBS)
doc: ЕМБС (единствен матичен број на субјектот), the 7-digit number of a legal entity in the Central Registry of the Republic of North Macedonia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MK-CR; with that prefix an identifier reads MK-CR-6524710.

name: Malian association registration number
doc: Registration number of an association at the Ministry of Territorial Administration of Mali. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ML-MAT; with that prefix an identifier reads ML-MAT-0003.

name: Malian tax identification number (NIF)
doc: Numéro d'identification fiscale (NIF), the tax identification number of taxpayers in Mali. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ML-NIF; with that prefix an identifier reads ML-NIF-085101101W.

name: Maritime Mobile Service Identity
doc: A Maritime Mobile Service Identity (MMSI) is a series of nine digits which are sent in digital form over a radio frequency channel in order to uniquely identify ship stations, ship earth stations, coast stations, coast earth stations, and group calls. These identities are formed in such a way that the identity or part thereof can be used by telephone and telex subscribers connected to the general telecommunications network to call ships automatically.

name: Molecular Formula
doc: Molecular formulae indicate the simple numbers of each type of atom in a molecule of a molecular substance.

name: Money amount
doc: Amount of money as numeric value

categories.name: All measurable values (percentage, amount and e.t.c)

name: MongoDB unique Object ID
doc: MongoDB ObjectId, the unique id that MongoDB assigns to each document of a collection as the field _id. It is a 12-byte value written as 24 hexadecimal characters.

name: Month
doc: Month as number since start of the year. Could be from 1 to 12

patterns.name: Month name (English)
patterns.doc: English name of the month

patterns.name: Short name of month (English)
patterns.doc: Abbreviated short English name/abbreviation of month

patterns.name: Month name (Russian)
patterns.doc: Name of a month in Russian in the nominative case, for example "январь" or "Февраль".

ru.name: Название месяца
ru.doc: Название месяца на русском языке в именительном падеже.

name: Month and day
doc: Defines a part of a date - the month and day. Example (MM-DD).

name: Mobile Subscriber ISDN Number (MSISDN)
doc: MSISDN is a number uniquely identifying a subscription in a Global System for Mobile communications or a Universal Mobile Telecommunications System mobile network. It is the mapping of the telephone number to the subscriber identity module in a mobile or cellular phone.

name: Maltese driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Malta. Microsoft Purview looks for two letters or digits and six digits in groups of three.

name: Maltese identity card number
doc: Number of the Maltese identity card: seven digits followed by one of the letters M, G, A, P, L, H, B or Z.

name: Maltese passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Malta. Microsoft Purview looks for seven digits.

name: Maltese tax identification number
doc: Maltese tax identification number. For Maltese nationals it is seven digits and a letter (the identity card number); for other persons and for entities it is nine digits.

name: Maltese VAT number
doc: VAT registration number in Malta: eight digits, the first not 0, with a weighted check.

name: Mauritian company number
doc: Company or partnership number (file number) in the Companies and Businesses Registration Integrated System (CBRIS) of Mauritius. It differs from the business registration number that some companies also have. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MU-CR; with that prefix an identifier reads MU-CR-C136127.

name: Mauritian national identity number
doc: National identity number of people in Mauritius, given at birth and printed on the National Identity Card. It has 14 characters: the first letter of the surname at birth, the date of birth (DDMMYY), a 6-digit unique number and a check character.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: Mexican public entity budget code
doc: Code of a public entity in the federal budget classification of public entities of Mexico (Clasificación Administrativa). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MX-CPA; with that prefix an identifier reads MX-CPA-4-121.

name: Mexico City public entity budget code
doc: Code of a public entity in the budget classification of public entities of Mexico City. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MX-CMX_CPA; with that prefix an identifier reads MX-CMX_CPA-01C001.

name: Mexican municipality
doc: Name of a municipality (municipio) of Mexico, the level below the state, such as Guadalajara or Monterrey. Mexico has about 2,470 municipalities; Mexico City is divided into 16 boroughs (alcaldías) instead.

name: Mexican postal code
doc: Postal code (código postal) in Mexico: five digits. The first two digits identify the state; codes of Mexico City start with 01 to 16.

name: Mexican state (province)
doc: Mexican state/province by name or code

name: Malaysian identity card number (NRIC)
doc: National Registration Identity Card number (MyKad number) of Malaysian citizens and permanent residents. It has twelve digits: the date of birth (YYMMDD), a 2-digit birth place code and four digits, the last of which is odd for males and even for females. It is often written with hyphens after the sixth and eighth digits.

Synthetic number in the documented format
The first example in its printed form

name: Malaysian company registration number (SSM)
doc: Registration number of a company at the Companies Commission of Malaysia (Suruhanjaya Syarikat Malaysia, SSM). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MY-SSM; with that prefix an identifier reads MY-SSM-993856H.

name: Japanese My Number (マイナンバー) by known name
doc: Japanese My Number (マイナンバー) by known name identifier

name: Namibian BIPA registration number
doc: Registration number of a company, close corporation or other entity at the Business and Intellectual Property Authority (BIPA) of Namibia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as NA-BIPA; with that prefix an identifier reads NA-BIPA-CC-2017-11330.

name: Namibian taxpayer identification number
doc: Taxpayer number that the Namibia Revenue Agency (NamRA) gives to taxpayers. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as NA-NAMRA; with that prefix an identifier reads NA-NAMRA-04822224.

name: NAICS code
doc: Classification in the North American Industry Classification System

name: Name
doc: Name of the item, object or entity.

name: Name suffix
doc: Word, abbreviation or numeral written after a person's surname. It can be generational (Jr., Sr., III), academic (PhD), an honour (OBE), professional or military.

examples.description: honour (Officer of the Order of the British Empire)

name: North American phone number (NANP)
doc: Ten-digit telephone number of the North American Numbering Plan (NANP), the shared numbering plan of country code 1 used by the United States, Canada and several Caribbean and Pacific territories. The number is a three-digit area code, a three-digit central office code and a four-digit line number. The area code and the central office code start with a digit from 2 to 9. Common notations are NPA-NXX-XXXX and (NPA) NXX-XXXX, with an optional leading 1 or +1.

examples.description: (NPA) NXX-XXXX notation; 555-0100 to 555-0199 are reserved for fictional use
Parentheses without a space, as in the D3M definition
An area code cannot start with 0 or 1
Seven-digit local number without an area code

ru.name: Североамериканский номер телефона (NANP)
ru.doc: Десятизначный номер телефона по Североамериканскому плану нумерации (NANP) с кодом страны 1. Используется в США, Канаде и ряде территорий Карибского бассейна и Тихого океана. Состоит из трёхзначного кода региона, трёхзначного кода станции и четырёхзначного номера абонента.

name: Person nationality
doc: Nationality of the person from list of unique code from one of code lists or defined somehow else.

patterns.name: Person nationality in English
patterns.doc: Nationality of the person written in English

name: NATO Stock Number (NSN)
doc: Thirteen-digit code of a standardized item of supply in the NATO Codification System, called National Stock Number in the United States. The first four digits are the NATO Supply Classification group and class. The remaining nine digits are the National Item Identification Number (NIIN): two digits for the National Codification Bureau of the country that first codified the item, then seven digits. The usual notation is NNNN-NN-NNN-NNNN; the hyphens are optional.

examples.description: The country code must have two digits

name: NCBI Gene ID (Entrez Gene)
doc: Numeric identifier of a gene record in the NCBI Gene database (formerly Entrez Gene) of the US National Center for Biotechnology Information. Gene records cover many species. PubChem gene pages use this ID, as in https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/3123.

examples.description: Alkaline phosphatase gene of Bacillus cereus ATCC 14579

ru.name: Идентификатор гена NCBI (Entrez Gene)
ru.doc: Числовой идентификатор записи о гене в базе данных NCBI Gene.

name: ArcGIS object ID (OBJECTID)
doc: Row identifier that Esri ArcGIS adds to every geodatabase table and feature class. The default field name is OBJECTID, or OBJECTID_1 when a column of that name already exists, and ArcGIS displays it as OID or ObjectID, and as FID in shapefiles and web feature layers. ArcGIS maintains the values. Each is a non-null integer that is unique only within its table, so the same number names different rows in different layers; Global IDs serve to identify rows across geodatabases. The field is a 32-bit integer by default, up to 2,147,483,647, and ArcGIS Pro can migrate it to a 64-bit object ID limited to 9,007,199,254,740,991. Datasets exported from ArcGIS keep it as an objectid or OBJECTID column, for example on Opendatasoft portals next to geo_point_2d and geo_shape, where it is sometimes stored as a decimal number such as 89.0. It is not the MongoDB ObjectId (mongodbid).

In September 2013, the OCLC declared these numbers to be in the public domain, removing a perceived barrier to widespread use of OCNs outside OCLC itself.[42] The control numbers link WorldCat's records to local library system records by providing a common reference key for a record across libraries

IDs are positive 64-bit integers that are unique only within one element type, so node 100 and way 100 are different objects. Datasets write the ID as a bare number, with a type letter (n, w or r; N, W or R in Nominatim), or as type/number like in OpenStreetMap URLs. osm2pgsql stores relation IDs as negative numbers.

doc: 24-bit number that the IEEE Registration Authority assigns to a vendor or other organization (MA-L assignment). It forms the first three octets of MAC addresses and other EUI-48 and EUI-64 identifiers made by that organization, and is also used in World Wide Names and SNAP protocol identifiers. It is written as three hexadecimal octets, separated by hyphens or colons or not at all.

name: Pubkey hash (P2PKH address)
doc: A Bitcoin address is only a hash, so the sender can't provide a full public key in scriptPubKey. When redeeming coins that have been sent to a Bitcoin address, the recipient provides both the signature and the public key. The script verifies that the provided public key does hash to the hash in scriptPubKey, and then it also checks the signature against the public key.

name: Script hash (P2SH address)
doc: Pay to script hash (P2SH) transactions were standardised in BIP 16. They allow transactions to be sent to a script hash (address starting with 3) instead of a public key hash (addresses starting with 1). To spend bitcoins sent via P2SH, the recipient must provide a script matching the script hash and data which makes the script evaluate to true.

doc: Number of a passport issued by Portugal. Microsoft Purview looks for a letter and six digits.

name: Portuguese postal code
doc: Postal code (código postal) in Portugal: four digits, a hyphen and three digits. The first four digits name the area, the last three a street or a large customer.

name: PubChem Substance ID (SID)
doc: PubChem is a database of chemical molecules and their activities against biological assays. The system is maintained by the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), a component of the National Library of Medicine, which is part of the United States National Institutes of Health (NIH).

name: Publisher Item Identifier (PII)
doc: Identifier of an article or chapter, used since 1996 by Elsevier, the American Chemical Society, the American Physical Society, IEEE and other publishers. It has 17 characters: S for a serial or B for a book, the ISSN or ISBN of the publication, for serials two more digits (often the year), a five-digit item number and a check character. In print it is often punctuated as Sxxxx-xxxx(yy)iiiii-d. Elsevier uses the PII as the item part of its DOIs.

examples.description: Article in Bioorganic & Medicinal Chemistry Letters, printed form
The same PII as a 17-character string
The item number must have five digits

name: Persistent Uniform Resource Locator (PURL)
doc: URL on a PURL resolver that redirects to the current location of a resource, so that the published address keeps working when the resource moves. The original resolver at purl.org, now run by the Internet Archive, also answers at purl.net, purl.com and purl.info. Other resolvers use host names that start with purl, such as purl.fdlp.gov. Dublin Core publishes its term URIs as PURLs.

examples.description: Not hosted on a PURL resolver

name: Paraguayan national budget entity code
doc: Code of a public entity in the classification of entities of the General Budget of the Nation (Presupuesto General de la Nación) of Paraguay. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as PY-PGN; with that prefix an identifier reads PY-PGN-12.

name: Paraguayan taxpayer number (RUC)
doc: Registro Único del Contribuyente, the tax number of persons and legal entities in Paraguay. Legal entities have eight digits starting from 80000000; persons have up to nine digits. The last digit is a check digit, usually written after a hyphen.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit
The first example in its printed form

name: Qatari establishment number
doc: Establishment number that the Ministry of Interior of Qatar gives to companies and other organisations. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as QA-MOI; with that prefix an identifier reads QA-MOI-01005700.

name: Qatari identity card number (QID)
doc: Number of the Qatari identity card: 11 digits. The first digit is 2 or 3, then come the last two digits of the year of birth and a three-digit country code.

name: Quantity
doc: Number of something, quantity

categories.name: All measurable values (percentage, amount and e.t.c)

name: Quarter of the year
doc: A calendar quater of the year

patterns.name: Quarter of the year (Russian)
patterns.doc: Calendar quarter written in Russian with an Arabic or Roman number, optionally followed by the year, for example "1 квартал" or "II квартал 2026 года".

ru.name: Квартал
ru.doc: Квартал года в русской записи.

name: Race or ethnicity
doc: Race or ethnic group of a person as recorded in surveys, health records and administrative data, for example Asian, Black or African American, or Hispanic or Latino. Values follow a local classification, such as the US Census categories, and are sometimes one-letter codes. Racial or ethnic origin is a special category of personal data under the GDPR.

name: re3data repository ID
doc: Identifier of a research data repository in re3data, the Registry of Research Data Repositories. It is r3d followed by a number of up to nine digits.

name: References (Email Header)
doc: References is an email header field that contains a list of Message-IDs of messages in the reply chain, as defined in RFC 5322. It is used to maintain threading in email conversations.

name: Religion
doc: Religion, religious denomination or worldview of a person or a group, such as Catholic, Sunni Islam or Buddhism. Censuses and surveys often record it. Under the GDPR, data that reveals a person's religious beliefs is a special category of personal data.

name: ResearcherID
doc: ResearcherID is an identifying system for scientific authors. The system was introduced in January 2008 by Thomson Reuters.

name: Mexican RFC (Registro Federal de Contribuyentes) by known name
doc: Mexican RFC (Registro Federal de Contribuyentes) by known name identifier

name: Brazilian RG (Registro Geral) by known name
doc: Brazilian RG (Registro Geral) by known name identifier

name: RGB color triplet
doc: Color written as its red, green and blue components: three integers from 0 to 255 separated by commas, either bare (220,220,220) or in the CSS functional notation rgb(220, 220, 220). Design tools, data exports and stylesheets use it; the hexadecimal form of the same color is hexcolor. The regexp does not cover percentages, an alpha channel or the space-separated syntax of CSS Color Level 4.

ru.name: Цвет RGB
ru.doc: Цвет, записанный тремя компонентами (красный, зелёный, синий) от 0 до 255.

name: Reuters Instrument Code (RIC)
doc: A Reuters instrument code, or RIC, is a ticker-like code used by Refinitiv to identify financial instruments and indices. The codes are used for looking up information on various Refinitiv financial information networks (such as Refinitiv Real Time) and appear to have developed from the Quotron service purchased in the 1980s.

examples.description: IBM being traded on the New York Stock Exchang
IBM being traded on London Stock Exchange

name: Rich PE Header hash
doc: The Rich header is an undocumented header contained within PE files compiled and linked using the Microsoft toolchain. It contains information about the build environment that the PE file was created in.

name: RIPEMD-160 hash
doc: Digest of the RIPEMD-160 hash function (160 bits), used for example in Bitcoin addresses. It is written as 40 hexadecimal digits. SHA-1 and RIPEMD-160 digests have the same length, so the value alone does not tell them apart: use the field name or context.

examples.description: RIPEMD-160 hash of the empty string
one hex digit short (39 instead of 40)

name: Russian government property ID (RNFI)
doc: Russian government federal property unique ID (RNFI)

name: Romanian VAT code (CF)
doc: Cod de înregistrare în scopuri de TVA, the VAT registration code in Romania: the company identifier (CUI) of 2 to 10 digits, usually written with the RO prefix. Some sources also accept a 13-digit personal numerical code (CNP).

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

ro.name: Cod de înregistrare în scopuri de TVA

name: Romanian personal numerical code (CNP)
doc: Cod numeric personal, the 13-digit personal identifier in Romania. It encodes the sex and century of birth, the date of birth (YYMMDD), the county of birth or registration, a serial number and a check digit.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: Romanian company identifier (CUI, CIF)
doc: Codul unic de înregistrare, also called codul de identificare fiscală (CIF), the fiscal identifier of companies and other entities in Romania. It has 2 to 10 digits, the last being a check digit. The RO prefix shows that the entity is registered for VAT.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: Romanian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Romania. Microsoft Purview looks for a letter or digit followed by eight digits.

name: Romanian trade register number (ONRC)
doc: Registration number in the Romanian Trade Register (Oficiul Național al Registrului Comerțului). The old form is a letter for the kind of entity, a county code, a serial number and the registration year, separated by slashes. Since July 2024 a 14-character form without slashes is used: the letter, the year, a serial number, the county code and a check digit.

ro.name: Număr de ordine în Registrul Comerțului

name: Romanian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Romania. Microsoft Purview looks for eight or nine digits.

name: Romanian postal code
doc: Postal code (cod poștal) in Romania: six digits, used since 2003. Bucharest codes start with 0, and their second digit is the sector.

name: Roman numeral
doc: Number from 1 to 3999 written in Roman numerals, with the letters I, V, X, L, C, D and M in the standard subtractive form, where IV is 4 and CM is 900. Roman numerals number volumes, chapters, monarchs and recurring events, and some copyright notices and inscriptions give years in them. The regexp accepts uppercase standard forms only, not additive variants such as IIII or numbers above 3999.

categories.name: All measurable values (percentage, amount and e.t.c)

ru.name: Римское число
ru.doc: Число от 1 до 3999, записанное римскими цифрами I, V, X, L, C, D и M.

name: ROR Identifier (ROR ID)
doc: Research Organization Registry (ROR) is a community-led database that aims to provide a persistent identifier for every research institution in the world.[1] It complements other commonly used identifiers such as ORCID for researchers and DOI for research output.

name: Research Resource Identifier (RRID)
doc: Persistent identifier for a research resource such as an antibody, cell line, model organism, plasmid or software tool, cited in scientific papers as RRID:<prefix>_<id> or RRID:<prefix><id>. The prefix names the source database, for example AB for antibodies, CVCL for Cellosaurus cell lines and SCR for software and databases. RRIDs are registered through SciCrunch.

examples.description: Without the RRID: prefix the value is not recognized

name: Serbian company registration number (matični broj)
doc: Matični broj, the 8-digit registration number of a company in the registers of the Serbian Business Registers Agency (APR). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as RS-APR; with that prefix an identifier reads RS-APR-06115403.

name: Serbian tax identification number (PIB)
doc: Poreski identifikacioni broj (PIB), the 9-digit tax identification number of companies and entrepreneurs in Serbia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as RS-PIB; with that prefix an identifier reads RS-PIB-100000709.

name: RSIN op veldnaam
doc: NL datatype for 'RSIN op veldnaam' (rsin) from rules in context 'companies'.

name: RTECS number
doc: Identifier of a substance in the Registry of Toxic Effects of Chemical Substances (RTECS), a toxicity database started by the US National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH). It is two uppercase letters followed by seven digits.

ru.name: Номер RTECS
ru.doc: Номер вещества в Реестре токсических эффектов химических веществ (RTECS).

name: Russian age rating of information products
doc: Age category of information products under the Russian Federal Law No. 436-FZ on the protection of children from information harmful to their health and development. The law sets five categories, marked 0+, 6+, 12+, 16+ and 18+. Films, books, events and websites carry the mark.

examples.description: Not a category of the law

patterns.name: Russian age rating with its explanation
patterns.doc: Age category of information products under Federal Law No. 436-FZ written as the mark in guillemets followed by its explanation, such as «12+» для детей старше 12 лет. The register of film distribution certificates of the Russian Ministry of Culture uses this form.

examples.description: Category of the film classification used before Law No. 436-FZ

patterns.name: Russian age rating as a number
patterns.doc: Age category of information products under Federal Law No. 436-FZ written as a bare number without the plus sign (0, 6, 12, 16 or 18), as in the age limit field of the Russian film register. Older film records also contain 14, a category of the classification used before the law; it is not covered.

examples.description: Category of the film classification used before Law No. 436-FZ

name: Russian age rating with its explanation
doc: Age category of information products under Federal Law No. 436-FZ written as the mark in guillemets followed by its explanation, such as «12+» для детей старше 12 лет. The register of film distribution certificates of the Russian Ministry of Culture uses this form.

examples.description: Category of the film classification used before Law No. 436-FZ

name: Russian age rating as a number
doc: Age category of information products under Federal Law No. 436-FZ written as a bare number without the plus sign (0, 6, 12, 16 or 18), as in the age limit field of the Russian film register. Older film records also contain 14, a category of the classification used before the law; it is not covered.

examples.description: Category of the film classification used before Law No. 436-FZ

name: Russian alcohol retail license number
doc: Number of a license for retail sale of alcoholic products issued by a regional authority. It consists of the two-digit region code, three letters and a seven-digit sequence number, for example "37РАО0000001". The letters РПА and РАО are both seen in regional registers on data.gov.ru.

examples.description: License of a company, Ivanovo region register
License of a company, Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug register

ru.name: Номер лицензии на розничную продажу алкогольной продукции
ru.doc: Номер лицензии на розничную продажу алкогольной продукции из кода региона, трёх букв и семизначного порядкового номера.

name: Russian construction or commissioning permit number
doc: Number of a permit for construction or for putting a building into operation in Russia. Datasets on data.gov.ru use two forms - region code, "RU" with the municipality code, sequence number and year ("86-RU86311000-1-2021"), and a shorter form of hyphen-separated numbers ending with the year ("86-09-01-2026"). Some regions use their own forms that the regexp does not cover.

examples.description: Construction permit for a hospital building, Uray
Commissioning permit for a workshop, Sovetsky district

ru.name: Номер разрешения на строительство или ввод объекта в эксплуатацию
ru.doc: Номер разрешения на строительство или на ввод объекта в эксплуатацию.

name: Date period (Russian)
doc: Period between two dates, months or years written in Russian notation, for example "с 01.2025 по 12.2025" or "01.01.2025-31.12.2025". Often used for the period covered by an inspection or a project.

ru.name: Период
ru.doc: Период между двумя датами, месяцами или годами в русской записи.

name: Accounting number of a Russian cultural heritage object (EGROKN)
doc: Accounting number (учётный номер) of an object in the open data of the Russian Unified State Register of Cultural Heritage Objects (ЕГРОКН). It is written as the two-digit code of the federal subject, a hyphen and a sequence number, such as 56-142. The region prefix agrees with the region of the record in 99.99% of 110 000 records. It differs from the fifteen-digit registration number.

ru.name: Учётный номер объекта культурного наследия в ЕГРОКН

name: Registration number of a Russian cultural heritage object (EGROKN)
doc: Fifteen-digit registration number of an object in the Unified State Register of Cultural Heritage Objects of the Peoples of the Russian Federation (ЕГРОКН), kept by the Ministry of Culture. The number has the structure СС ГГ В XXXXXX ППП К: the code of the federal subject (two digits), the last two digits of the year the record was entered (two), the kind of object (one: 1 monument, 2 ensemble, 3 landmark site, 4 archaeological heritage object), a sequence number (six), the component of a composite object (three) and the category of historical and cultural significance (one: 4 local, 5 regional, 6 federal; 7 to 9 for objects on the World Heritage List and especially valuable objects). In the open data of the Ministry the kind and category digits agree with the attributes of the record in 99.7% of 110 000 records.

examples.description: Monument of regional significance in Orenburg Oblast, entered in 2015
Ensemble of regional significance in Krasnodar Krai
Landmark site of regional significance in Tomsk Oblast
Chinese Theatre in Tsarskoye Selo, a monument of federal significance (Wikidata example)
Ensemble of federal significance in Moscow, from data.mos.ru
Accounting number of the register, the datatype ru_egrokn_accounting_number

ru.name: Регистрационный номер объекта культурного наследия в ЕГРОКН
ru.doc: Пятнадцатизначный регистрационный номер объекта в Едином государственном реестре объектов культурного наследия (памятников истории и культуры) народов Российской Федерации со структурой СС ГГ В XXXXXX ППП К. Здесь СС — код субъекта РФ, ГГ — год внесения записи, В — вид объекта, XXXXXX — порядковый номер, ППП — пообъектный состав, К — категория историко-культурного значения.

name: Identifier in the Russian Unified Information Space of Culture (EIPSK)
doc: Numeric identifier of a place, an organization or an event in the Unified Information Space in the Sphere of Culture (ЕИПСК). The open data of the Russian Ministry of Culture about theatres, museums, libraries, cinemas and other institutions uses these identifiers, and place records link to their pages on culture.ru. Places and organizations are numbered separately, so the same number may denote different objects. The identifiers are positive integers; in the open data of the Ministry they have up to five digits. Many other identifiers look the same, so the field name matters more than the value.

ru.name: Идентификатор ЕИПСК
ru.doc: Числовой идентификатор места, организации или мероприятия в Едином информационном пространстве в сфере культуры (ЕИПСК).

name: Russian control (supervisory) measure number in ЕРКНМ
doc: Registration number of a control (supervisory) measure, such as a planned inspection, in the Russian Unified Register of Control (Supervisory) Measures (ФГИС ЕРКНМ). It is a 20-digit number, so it has the same form as a budget classification code or a bank account number and is identified by the field name, for example "учетный номер КНМ в системе ФГИС ЕРКНМ".

examples.description: Planned inspection of a federal enterprise, Saint Petersburg
Planned external control of an audit company, Chelyabinsk

ru.name: Учётный номер КНМ в ЕРКНМ
ru.doc: Учётный номер контрольного (надзорного) мероприятия в Едином реестре контрольных (надзорных) мероприятий.

name: Russian film distribution certificate number
doc: Number of a film distribution certificate (прокатное удостоверение), which the Russian Ministry of Culture issues for showing and distributing a film and records in the federal register of certificates. Current numbers have nine digits, the last two being the year of issue (99.8% of 113 621 records in the open data of the Ministry), and begin with 1 or 2. Older certificates have eight digits, and numbers issued in 1998-2003 may end with the letter Д.

examples.description: Number with the letter Д, issued in 2002
Number of a national film certificate, the datatype ru_national_film_certificate

name: Kind of film in the Russian film registers
doc: Kind of film (вид фильма) in the registers of the Russian Ministry of Culture, such as feature (художественный), documentary (документальный), animated (анимационный) or popular science (научно-популярный). The registers write the values inconsistently, with about sixty variants.

name: Precision of the creation date of a museum object in the Russian State Catalogue
doc: Precision with which the State Catalogue of the Museum Fund of the Russian Federation (Госкаталог) records the creation date of a museum object. The open data of the Ministry of Culture uses the values DAY, MONTH, YEAR, CENTURY and EPOCH.

examples.description: The catalogue writes the values in capitals

ru.name: Точность датировки музейного предмета в Госкаталоге

name: Registration number of a museum object in the Russian State Catalogue (Goskatalog)
doc: Registration number of a museum object in the State Catalogue of the Museum Fund of the Russian Federation (Госкаталог), which the Ministry of Culture keeps at goskatalog.ru. In the open data of the Ministry it is an integer of seven or eight digits.

examples.description: Teapot from a tea set in a municipal museum
Number in the museum's book of acquisitions, not the catalogue number

ru.name: Регистрационный номер музейного предмета в Госкаталоге

name: Typology of a museum object in the Russian State Catalogue (Goskatalog)
doc: Typology group of a museum object in the State Catalogue of the Museum Fund of the Russian Federation (Госкаталог). The open data of the Ministry of Culture uses fifteen groups, such as graphic art, painting, sculpture, numismatics, documents, photographs and negatives, rare books and archaeology.

examples.value: предметы прикладного искусства, быта и этнографии

name: Historical dating in Russian
doc: Approximate date of creation of a historical or museum object written in Russian, with a century in Roman numerals, a millennium, a decade or a year and qualifiers such as начало, конец or вторая половина. Registers of cultural heritage and museum objects use this free form, so it has no regular expression.

name: Russian license number in the Unified Register of Licenses (ЕРУЛ)
doc: Registration number of a license in the Russian Unified Register of Licenses (ЕРУЛ), in the format "ЛNNN-NNNNN-NN/NNNNNNNN". Used by different licensing authorities, for example for private security and for technical protection of confidential information. In the licence registers on the Moscow open data portal (data.mos.ru) the first group depends on the licensed activity (Л035 education, Л041 medical, Л042 pharmaceutical, Л017 narcotic drugs, Л028 scrap metal) and the second group on the licensing authority. Some of these datasets write the separators as en dashes, which the regexp also accepts.

examples.description: Private security license of a company
Licence for educational activity issued in Moscow
The same form written with en dashes, as in some data.mos.ru datasets
Series of a licence blank form, not the registration number

ru.name: Номер лицензии в ЕРУЛ
ru.doc: Регистрационный номер лицензии в Едином реестре учёта лицензий в формате «ЛNNN-NNNNN-NN/NNNNNNNN».

name: Russian license number (ЛО- format)
doc: Number of a license for medical or pharmaceutical activity in the format "ЛО-NN-NN-NNNNNN", issued before the Unified Register of Licenses (ЕРУЛ) numbering. In the license registers published on data.gov.ru the first two digits match the region code of the licensing authority (34 for Volgograd region, 66 for Sverdlovsk region); the second group is 01 in medical activity registers and 02 in pharmaceutical activity registers.

examples.description: Pharmaceutical activity license of a company, Volgograd region register
Medical activity license of an organization, Sverdlovsk region register

ru.name: Номер лицензии (формат ЛО-)
ru.doc: Номер лицензии на медицинскую или фармацевтическую деятельность в формате «ЛО-NN-NN-NNNNNN», который применялся до нумерации Единого реестра учёта лицензий.

name: Russian Ministry of Culture license number for heritage preservation
doc: Number of a license for activities to preserve cultural heritage objects, which the Russian Ministry of Culture issued before licenses moved to the Unified Register of Licenses. It is written as МКРФ and five digits, such as МКРФ 24056; duplicates of a license use the same form. Licenses issued later have numbers of the type ru_license_erul.

examples.description: Number in the Unified Register of Licenses, the datatype ru_license_erul

ru.name: Номер лицензии Минкультуры России на сохранение объектов культурного наследия

name: Month name (Russian)
doc: Name of a month in Russian in the nominative case, for example "январь" or "Февраль".

ru.name: Название месяца
ru.doc: Название месяца на русском языке в именительном падеже.

name: Moscow open data portal record identifier (global_id)
doc: Numeric identifier of a record in a dataset of the Moscow open data portal data.mos.ru. Every dataset of the portal has it in the field global_id, and rows of nested tables carry their own global_id. The portal assigns the number; it is not derived from the object that the record describes. In the snapshot of November 2026 the values have 7 to 10 digits, and a few have 12.

examples.description: Record of the dataset "Дома культуры и клубы" (houses of culture and clubs)

ru.name: Идентификатор записи на портале открытых данных Москвы (global_id)
ru.doc: Числовой идентификатор записи набора данных на портале data.mos.ru. Есть в поле global_id каждого набора данных портала и во вложенных таблицах. Номер присваивает портал, он не зависит от описываемого объекта.

name: Moscow Metro line name
doc: Name of a line of the Moscow Metro, such as Сокольническая линия, Большая кольцевая линия or Московское центральное кольцо. The Moscow open data portal publishes the list of lines, with their numbers and status, as the dataset "Линии Московского метрополитена".

name: Moscow Metro station name
doc: Name of a station of the Moscow Metro, including the stations of the Moscow Central Circle. Datasets of the Moscow open data portal use it to give the nearest station of an object. The portal publishes the list of stations, with their lines, as the dataset "Станции Московского метрополитена".

name: Moscow address register object number (UNOM)
doc: Number of an addressed object (a building or a structure) in the Address register of real estate objects of Moscow. Datasets of the Moscow open data portal publish it in the field UNOM, labelled "Код адреса по АР" or "УНОМ", to link their records to buildings, and the register itself is published there as a dataset. Values are positive integers of up to 7 digits.

examples.description: Cadastral number of a building, not a UNOM

ru.name: Уникальный номер объекта адресации в Адресном реестре Москвы (УНОМ)
ru.doc: Номер объекта адресации (здания, сооружения) в Адресном реестре объектов недвижимости города Москвы. В наборах данных портала data.mos.ru публикуется в поле UNOM и связывает записи со зданиями.

name: Russian national film certificate number
doc: Number of a national film certificate (удостоверение национального фильма), which the Russian Ministry of Culture issues to confirm that a film is a national film. The numbers are sequential integers, such as 37343; in the open data of the Ministry they have up to six digits. Many other numbers look the same, so the field name matters more than the value.

examples.description: Number of a distribution certificate, the datatype ru_film_distribution_certificate

name: Category of historical and cultural significance of a Russian heritage object
doc: Category of historical and cultural significance of a cultural heritage object under Article 4 of Federal Law No. 73-FZ. An object is of federal, regional or local (municipal) significance. The register of cultural heritage objects (ЕГРОКН) writes the categories as Федерального значения, Регионального значения and Местного (муниципального) значения.

examples.description: Not a category of Law No. 73-FZ

ru.name: Категория историко-культурного значения объекта культурного наследия

name: Kind of a Russian cultural heritage object
doc: Kind of a cultural heritage object under Article 3 of Federal Law No. 73-FZ on cultural heritage objects. The law distinguishes monuments (памятник), ensembles (ансамбль) and landmark sites (достопримечательное место). The register of cultural heritage objects (ЕГРОКН) records the kind of each object.

examples.description: Typology of the object, the datatype ru_okn_typology

name: Typology of a Russian cultural heritage object
doc: General typology (общая видовая принадлежность) of a cultural heritage object in the register of cultural heritage objects (ЕГРОКН), such as a monument of archaeology, of history, of urban planning and architecture, or of monumental art. An object can have several typologies.

ru.name: Общая видовая принадлежность объекта культурного наследия

name: Code SIRET par nom de champ
doc: FR datatype for 'Code SIRET par nom de champ' (siret) from rules in context 'finances'. The SIRET (Système d'Identification du Répertoire des Établissements) is a unique 14-digit identifier assigned to each business establishment in France. It consists of two parts: the first 9 digits are the SIREN number (identifying the legal entity or company), and the last 5 digits are the NIC (Numéro Interne de Classement), where the first 4 digits identify the specific establishment and the last digit is a check digit calculated using the Luhn algorithm. The SIRET number is used for official identification and registration of business establishments in France.

name: SMILES chemical notation
doc: Simplified Molecular-Input Line-Entry System (SMILES): a line notation that writes the structure of a molecule as a short ASCII string. Atoms are written by their element symbols, double and triple bonds by = and #, branches in parentheses and ring closures by digits; lowercase letters mark aromatic atoms. One molecule has many valid SMILES strings. Canonical SMILES picks one of them, and isomeric SMILES also records stereochemistry and isotopes. PubChem and Wikidata publish both forms. The record has no regexp: the SMILES character set also matches ordinary words, so a chemistry parser such as RDKit or Open Babel is needed to check a value.

doc: Name of a biological species, either its scientific name, such as Panthera leo, or a common name, such as lion. Typical columns are in biodiversity observations, fishery and forestry statistics, and in machine learning datasets such as Iris. The animal record covers common names of animals.

name: Square access token
doc: Personal or OAuth access token of the Square APIs. Square does not document the format; secret scanners such as gitleaks recognize it by the prefix EAAA or the older prefix sq0atp- followed by 22 to 60 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

name: US Social Security Number
doc: In the United States, a Social Security number (SSN) is a nine-digit number issued to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and temporary (working) residents under section 205(c)(2) of the Social Security Act, codified as 42 U.S.C. § 405(c)(2)

name: Serial shipping container code
doc: Serial Shipping Container Code (SSCC) written as a GS1 element string with Application Identifier (00): '00' followed by the 18 digits of the SSCC. The SSCC identifies one logistic unit, such as a pallet or a parcel, for its whole journey through the supply chain; it is an extension digit, a GS1 Company Prefix, a serial reference and a GS1 check digit. It is usually printed in a GS1-128 barcode on the logistic label or stored in an RFID tag.

name: Street suffix (street type)

name: Stripe secret or restricted API key
doc: Server-side API key of Stripe. Secret keys start with sk_ and restricted keys with rk_, followed by test_ for a sandbox or live_ for live mode. Publishable keys (pk_) are meant to be public and are not covered.

name: Tag URI
doc: Unique identifier in the tag URI scheme defined by RFC 4151. It has the form tag:<authority>,<date>:<specific>. The authority is a domain name or an email address that the issuer controlled on the given date. The date is written as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Anyone who holds a domain name or email address can mint tags without central registration. YAML uses tag URIs to name its data types.

name: Tanzanian business registration number (BRELA)
doc: Registration number of a company or business name at the Business Registrations and Licensing Agency (BRELA) of Tanzania. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as TZ-BRLA; with that prefix an identifier reads TZ-BRLA-135919098.

name: Tanzanian NGO registration number
