name: Tanzanian taxpayer identification number (TIN)
doc: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) that the Tanzania Revenue Authority gives to taxpayers. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as TZ-TRA; with that prefix an identifier reads TZ-TRA-101091759.

name: Ukrainian EDRPOU code
doc: Код ЄДРПОУ, the 8-digit identification code of a legal entity in the Unified State Register of Ukraine. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as UA-EDR; with that prefix an identifier reads UA-EDR-38422948.

name: Ukrainian international passport number
doc: Number of a Ukrainian passport for travel abroad. Microsoft Purview looks for two letters or digits followed by six digits.

name: Ukrainian domestic passport number
doc: Number of the Ukrainian internal (domestic) passport, which is now issued as an ID card. Microsoft Purview looks for nine digits.

name: Universal Decimal Classification (UDC)
doc: The Universal Decimal Classification (UDC) is a bibliographic and library classification representing the systematic arrangement of all branches of human knowledge organized as a coherent system in which knowledge fields are related and inter-linked.

ru.name: Индекс УДК (универсальная десятичная классификация)
ru.doc: Универсальная десятичная классификация — система классификации информации, широко используется во всём мире для систематизации произведений науки, литературы и искусства, периодической печати, различных видов документов и организации картотек.

name: Ugandan community-based organisation number (Jinja District)
doc: Registration number of a community-based organisation in Jinja District, Uganda. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as UG-204CBO; with that prefix an identifier reads UG-204CBO-JJA02202000348.

name: Ugandan NGO registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation at the National Bureau for NGOs of Uganda. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as UG-NGO; with that prefix an identifier reads UG-NGO-INDR160665542NB.

name: Ugandan URSB registration number
doc: Registration number of a company, business name or other entity at the Uganda Registration Services Bureau (URSB). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as UG-RSB; with that prefix an identifier reads UG-RSB-80010001803086.

name: UIC wagon number (European Vehicle Number)
doc: Twelve-digit number of a railway vehicle, such as a freight wagon, coach or locomotive, in the numbering system of the International Union of Railways (UIC), now the European Vehicle Number (EVN). Digits 1-2 give the vehicle type and interoperability, digits 3-4 the country of registration (before 2006, the owning railway), digits 5-8 the type of vehicle and digits 9-11 the serial number. Digit 12 is a check digit computed with the Luhn algorithm. On the vehicle the groups are separated by spaces and the check digit by a hyphen. Not to be confused with the UIC station code (uiccode).

ru.name: Номер вагона UIC (European Vehicle Number)
ru.doc: Двенадцатизначный номер железнодорожного подвижного состава по системе UIC; последняя цифра контрольная (алгоритм Луна).

name: UIC station code
doc: Identifier for a railway station in Europe, CIS countries, the Far East (China, Mongolia, Japan, Korea, Vietnam), North Africa and the Middle East

name: BNF code
doc: The British National Formulary (BNF) is a reference book containing the standard list of medicines used in UK prescribing. It gives information on the indications, dosages and side effects for over 70,000 medicines.

name: Borough code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK borough code identifying a borough, a type of local government administrative division within the United Kingdom.

name: District code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK district code identifying a district, a level of subnational division used for local government within the United Kingdom.

name: UK driver license number
doc: In the United Kingdom, a driving licence is the official document which authorises its holder to operate motor vehicles on highways and other public roads.

name: Education establishment number (United Kingdom)
doc: UK establishment number, an identifier assigned to schools and other education establishments in the United Kingdom (for example the DfE establishment/URN codes).

name: GSS code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK GSS (Government Statistical Service) code, the nine-character geographic code used by the Office for National Statistics to identify administrative and statistical geographies across the United Kingdom.

name: Local Authority code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK Local Authority (LA) code identifying a local authority, the administrative body responsible for local government within a defined area of the United Kingdom.

name: Middle Layer Super Output Area code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK Middle Layer Super Output Area (MSOA) code, a geography used by the Office for National Statistics for the reporting of small-area statistics.

name: UK NHS Number
doc: NHS numbers are the unique numbers allocated to registered users of the three public health services in England, Wales and the Isle of Man; the three health systems use a shared numbering scheme.

name: UK National Insurance number
doc: The National Insurance number is a number used in the United Kingdom in the administration of the National Insurance or social security system. It is also used for some purposes in the UK tax system.

name: ONS code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK ONS code, a geographic code assigned by the Office for National Statistics under the older ONS coding system for administrative and statistical geographies.

name: Parish code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK parish code identifying a civil parish, the lowest tier of local government in England.

name: British passport number
doc: Number of the passport issued by the United Kingdom

name: UK Postal code
doc: Postal codes used in the United Kingdom, British Overseas Territories and Crown dependencies are known as postcodes (originally, postal codes).

name: UK provider UKPRN

name: Lower Layer Super Output Area code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK Lower Layer Super Output Area (LSOA) code, a small-area geography used by the Office for National Statistics for the reporting of small-area statistics.

name: UK sort code

name: UK school URN

name: Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR)
doc: A UTR (unique taxpayer reference) number is a 10-digit number completely unique to each and every UK taxpayer.

name: Ward code (United Kingdom)
doc: Official code of a ward or electoral division in the United Kingdom: the electoral district represented by one or more councillors.

name: Ward name (United Kingdom)
doc: Name of a ward or electoral division in the United Kingdom: the electoral district represented by one or more councillors. The code is ukwardcode.

name: Unique Ingredient Identifier
doc: The Unique Ingredient Identifier (UNII) is an alphanumeric identifier linked to a substance molecular structure or descriptive information and is generated by the Global Substance Registration System (GSRS) of the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). It classifies substances as chemical, protein, nucleic acid, polymer, structurally diverse, or mixture according to the standards outlined by the International Organization for Standardization in ISO 11238 and ISO DTS 19844.

name: UniProtKB accession number
doc: Stable identifier of a protein entry in the UniProt Knowledgebase (UniProtKB), the protein sequence and function database of the UniProt consortium. An accession has 6 or 10 uppercase letters and digits in a fixed layout, which UniProt publishes as a regular expression. An entry keeps its primary accession across releases, and the accessions of entries merged into it remain as secondary accessions. It is not the mnemonic entry name, which has the form NAME_SPECIES.

name: Unix shadow password file entry
doc: One line of /etc/shadow on Linux and other Unix systems: nine colon-separated fields with the login name, the hashed password (or ! or * for a locked account), and the password ageing and expiry dates, counted in days since 1970-01-01.

name: Digital timestamp (Unix time, Epoch time, Posix time)
doc: Digital timestamp defined as Unix Time. It is a system for describing a point in time. It is the number of seconds that have elapsed since the Unix epoch, excluding leap seconds.

name: UN/LOCODE
doc: N/LOCODE, the United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations, is a geographic coding scheme developed and maintained by United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE). UN/LOCODE assigns codes to locations used in trade and transport with functions such as seaports, rail and road terminals, airports, Postal Exchange Office and border crossing points. The first issue in 1981 contained codes for 8,000 locations. The version from 2011 contained codes for about 82,000 locations.

name: UN M49
doc: UN M49 or the Standard Country or Area Codes for Statistical Use (Series M, No. 49) is a standard for area codes used by the United Nations for statistical purposes, developed and maintained by the United Nations Statistics Division.

name: UN Packaging group

doc: Code from the UNSPSC taxonomy of products and services used in e-commerce and procurement. It has eight digits: two each for segment, family, class and commodity. Upper levels have their own codes ending in 00. An optional ninth and tenth digit give the business function, such as retail or wholesale.

name: Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
doc: A Uniform Resource Locator (URL), colloquially termed a web address, is a reference to a web resource that specifies its location on a computer network and a mechanism for retrieving it. A URL is a specific type of Uniform Resource Identifier (URI), although many people use the two terms interchangeably

name: Uniform Resource Name (URN)
doc: Persistent, location-independent name in the urn URI scheme, defined by RFC 8141. It has the form urn:<NID>:<NSS>. The namespace identifier (NID) is a name registered with IANA, 2 to 32 letters, digits and hyphens long, such as isbn, uuid or ietf. The namespace-specific string (NSS) follows the rules of that namespace. The urn prefix is case-insensitive. A URN names a resource; it does not say where to retrieve it.

examples.description: The namespace identifier must be at least two characters long

name: US Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)
doc: Code of an item on the Commerce Control List of the US Export Administration Regulations. It has five characters: a digit for one of the ten categories, a letter from A to E for the product group, and three digits. The ECCN decides whether exporting the item needs a license. Items that are subject to the regulations but not listed are designated EAR99. Paragraph references such as .a.1 after the ECCN are not covered by the regexp.

name: GNIS Feature ID
doc: Numeric identifier of a named geographic feature in the Geographic Names Information System (GNIS), the official gazetteer of the United States kept by the US Geological Survey for the US Board on Geographic Names. It identifies populated places, administrative areas, streams, summits, structures and other features of the United States and its territories, and since 2024 also of Antarctica. The Census Bureau publishes the same number zero-padded to eight digits, for example STATENS 01779778 for California. Data Commons stores it in the gnisId property.

examples.description: zero-padded Census Bureau form of the same feature ID

name: US Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI)
doc: Medicare Beneficiary Identifier, the 11-character number on the Medicare card that replaced the SSN-based number from 2018. Letters S, L, O, I, B and Z are not used. It is often written with hyphens after the 4th and 7th characters.

examples.description: The letter S is not used

name: US National Drug Code (NDC)
doc: Ten-digit identifier of a drug package listed with the US Food and Drug Administration. It has three segments: the labeler code assigned by the FDA, the product code and the package code, both assigned by the labeler. The official form separates the segments with hyphens in one of the configurations 4-4-2, 5-3-2, 5-4-1, 6-3-2 or 6-4-1. Claims data under HIPAA use an 11-digit form without hyphens that pads the segments with zeros to 5-4-2.

examples.description: The same package in the 11-digit HIPAA form

name: US patent number
doc: Number of a United States patent document with the US country code and, often, the WIPO ST.16 kind code, as the USPTO recommends: for example "US 8,273,349 B2" for a granted patent. Granted utility patents have up to eight digits; prefixes mark reissues (RE), plant patents (PP), design patents (D) and statutory invention registrations (H). Patent application publications have the publication year and a seven-digit number; some sources, PubChem among them, drop the leading zero of that number. PubChem writes the parts with hyphens, as US-8273349-B2. Bare numbers without the US code are not covered.

name: RxNorm concept unique identifier (RXCUI)
doc: Numeric identifier of a concept in RxNorm, the US National Library of Medicine vocabulary of normalized names for clinical drugs on the US market. Ingredients, brand names and clinical drugs each have their own RXCUI.

name: Unique Entity ID (SAM.gov UEI)
doc: Unique Entity ID (UEI), the 12-character identifier of an entity registered in the US System for Award Management (SAM.gov). It replaced the DUNS number as the identifier of federal award recipients in 2022. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as US-SAM; with that prefix an identifier reads US-SAM-YNDUZMUZF8H8.

name: US ATIN (Adoption Taxpayer Identification Number)
doc: An ATIN is an Adoption Taxpayer Identification Number issued by the Internal Revenue Service as a temporary taxpayer identification number for the child in a domestic adoption where the adopting taxpayers do not have and/or are unable to obtain the child's Social Security Number (SSN).

name: Bank account in United States
doc: A bank account in the financial institutuin in United States

name: US County

name: USA DEA Registration (cerficicate) Number
doc: A DEA number (DEA Registration Number) is an identifier assigned to a health care provider (such as a physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, optometrist, podiatrist, dentist, or veterinarian) by the United States Drug Enforcement Administration allowing them to write prescriptions for controlled substances.

name: US driver license number
doc: Alphanumeric value of the United States driver license

name: US EIN (Employer Identification Number)
doc: An Employer Identification Number (EIN) is also known as a Federal Tax Identification Number, and is used to identify a business entity. Generally, businesses need an EIN.

name: HTTP User-Agent string
doc: Value of the User-Agent header that a browser, crawler, library or other HTTP client sends to describe itself. RFC 9110 defines it as one or more product identifiers, each a name with an optional /version, followed by comments in parentheses, such as the operating system. Most browsers start it with Mozilla/5.0 for historical compatibility. Web server logs and analytics data store it to tell browsers, devices and bots apart. The record has no regexp: the grammar is too loose to tell a user agent from other text.

examples.value: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:109.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/115.0

ru.name: Строка User-Agent
ru.doc: Значение HTTP-заголовка User-Agent, которым браузер, робот или другой клиент описывает себя.

name: User login credentials
doc: A user name and a password written together, for example in a configuration file, a command line or a script.

name: Federal Award Identification Number (FAIN)
doc: FAIN (Federal Award Identification Number) is the unique identifying number assigned to all federal finance awards. Since October of 2013, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) has required all Federal Agencies to issue a FAIN to all financial assistance awards or grants.

name: US FIPS property code by field name
doc: US FIPS property code by field name identifier

name: US ITIN (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number)
doc: A Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) is an identifying number used for tax purposes in the United States and in other countries under the Common Reporting Standard.

name: US National Provider Identifier (NPI)
doc: A National Provider Identifier (NPI) is a unique 10-digit identification number issued to health care providers in the United States by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).

doc: US order ID by field name identifier

name: US parcel number by field name
doc: US parcel number by field name identifier

doc: Number of US Passport

name: Procurement Instrument Identifier (PIID)
doc: The PIID consists of a combination of thirteen to seventeen alpha and/or numeric characters sequenced to convey certain information

name: USPS tracking number by field name
doc: USPS tracking number by field name identifier

name: US PTIN (Preparer Tax Identification Number)
doc: The Preparer Tax Identification Number (PTIN) is an identification number that all paid tax return preparers must use on U.S. federal tax returns or claims for refund submitted to the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).

name: US Social Security Number
doc: In the United States, a Social Security number (SSN) is a nine-digit number issued to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and temporary (working) residents under section 205(c)(2) of the Social Security Act, codified as 42 U.S.C. § 405(c)(2)

name: US State
doc: Name or code of US State

name: US Postal code
doc: A ZIP Code is a postal code used by the United States Postal Service (USPS). Introduced in 1963, the basic format consisted of five digits. In 1983, an extended ZIP+4 code was introduced; it included the five digits of the ZIP Code, followed by a hyphen and four digits that designated a more specific location.

name: UTC Timezone offset
doc: Difference between Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) and this timezone.

name: A universally unique identifier (UUID)
doc: A universally unique identifier (UUID) is a 128-bit label used for information in computer systems. The term globally unique identifier (GUID) is also used.

name: Uruguayan postal code
doc: Postal code (código postal) in Uruguay: five digits. Montevideo codes start with 11 or 12.

name: Uzbek KTUT code
doc: KTUT number (the OKPO code) of a legal entity in the United State Register of Enterprises and Organizations kept by the statistics agency of Uzbekistan. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as UZ-KTUT; with that prefix an identifier reads UZ-KTUT-2365119.

name: EU VAT ID
doc: A value-added tax identification number or VAT identification number (VATIN) is an identifier used in many countries, including the countries of the European Union, for value-added tax purposes.

name: Vehicle number
doc: Number of the vehicle (vehicle plate number)

name: Software version by field name
doc: Software version by field name

name: VHash
doc: Virustotal in-house similarity clustering algorithm value, based on a simple structural feature hash allows you to find similar files

name: VIAF ID
doc: Identifier of a cluster in the Virtual International Authority File (VIAF), an OCLC service that links the authority records of national libraries for the same person, organization, work or place. It has 2 to 9 or 19 to 22 digits and does not start with zero. Data Commons stores it in the viafId property.

doc: Vimeo video ID by field name identifier

name: Vehicle Identification Number by field name
doc: Vehicle Identification Number by field name number

name: Vietnamese foreign NGO registration number
doc: Registration number that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Viet Nam gives to a foreign non-governmental organisation to work in the country. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as VN-MFA; with that prefix an identifier reads VN-MFA-38-NVVH-HD.

name: Vietnamese Ministry of Science and Technology registration number
doc: Registration number of an organisation at the Ministry of Science and Technology of Viet Nam. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as VN-MOST; with that prefix an identifier reads VN-MOST-A399.

name: World Bank region
doc: World Bank regions are territorial classification of countries

name: Weight (mass)
doc: Weight of a person, an animal or a product, measured as mass in kilograms, grams, pounds or ounces. Datasets store it as a number, with the unit either in the value, such as "95 lbs.", or in the column name or metadata. The regular expression recognizes only values that carry one of these unit symbols.

categories.name: All measurable values (percentage, amount and e.t.c)

name: What3Words
doc: What3words is a proprietary geocode system designed to identify any location with a resolution of about 3 metres (9.8 ft). It is owned by What3words Limited, based in London, England.

name: WIF, compressed pubkey
doc: WIF, compressed pubkey

name: WIF, uncompressed pubkey
doc: WIF, uncompressed pubkey

name: Wikidata Id
doc: Wikidata makes use of identifiers for both internal organization of the knowledge base and for its connection to other databases.

name: Windows security identifier (SID)
doc: Identifier of a security principal in Microsoft Windows, such as a user account, group, computer or service. Its text form is S-1- followed by the identifier authority and up to 15 subauthorities, all decimal and separated by hyphens. Domain and local accounts have SIDs starting with S-1-5-21. Well-known SIDs, such as S-1-5-32-544 for the local Administrators group, are the same on all systems.

Well-known SID World, the group of all users

name: Windows Registry key
doc: Registry keys are container objects similar to folders. Registry values are non-container objects similar to files. Keys may contain values and subkeys. Keys are referenced with a syntax similar to Windows path names, using backslashes to indicate levels of hierarchy. Keys must have a case insensitive name without backslashes.

name: Well-known text (WKT) geometry
doc: Geometry written in the well-known text (WKT) markup of the OGC Simple Features standard (ISO 19125), such as POINT (30 10) or POLYGON ((30 10, 40 40, 20 40, 10 20, 30 10)). PostGIS also writes extended WKT (EWKT), which starts with the spatial reference id, as in SRID=4326;POINT (30 10).

name: WorldCat Entities ID
doc: Identifier of a person, place, work, event or other entity in WorldCat Entities, the linked data service of OCLC. It is the last segment of the entity URI https://id.oclc.org/worldcat/entity/<id>. OCLC publishes no formal grammar; identifiers seen in practice are 26 letters and digits that start with E39P or E39Q. It succeeds the WorldCat Identities ID.

examples.description: full entity URI, not the bare identifier

name: WorldCat Identities ID
doc: Key of a name page in WorldCat Identities, a retired OCLC research service that summarized the works by and about a person, organization or place. OCLC stopped updating it in July 2022 and replaced it with WorldCat Entities. The key is a prefix and a value - lccn- with a Library of Congress name authority number, viaf- with a VIAF ID, or np-, nc- or ns- with other text. Data Commons still stores it in the worldcatIdentitiesId property, and older datasets keep it.

examples.description: bare Library of Congress name authority number without the lccn- prefix

name: X.509 certificate private key
doc: Private key of an X.509 certificate, usually written as a PEM block that starts with -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- (or RSA PRIVATE KEY, EC PRIVATE KEY) or embedded in a Base64 PKCS #12 file.

name: Yemeni Ministry of Planning registration number
doc: Registration number of an organisation at the Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation of Yemen. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as YE-MOPIC; with that prefix an identifier reads YE-MOPIC-0036.

name: Yemeni Ministry of Social Affairs registration number
doc: Registration number of an association or foundation at the Ministry of Social Affairs and Labour of Yemen. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as YE-MSAL; with that prefix an identifier reads YE-MSAL-4/M/2012.

name: Year
doc: A calendar year in western notation like 2022 or 1913

name: Year range
doc: Span of calendar years written as two four-digit years joined by a hyphen, such as 2019-2020. It often names a season, an academic or fiscal year, or a reporting period.

examples.description: short form of the second year is not covered

name: Year and month
doc: Defines a part of a date - the year and month. Example YYYY-MM.

patterns.name: Month and year (Russian)
patterns.doc: Month written as a Russian month name followed by a year, optionally with "года" or "г.", for example "Февраль 2027 года" or "январь 2013".

doc: YouTube video ID by field name identifier

name: South African company registration number (CIPC)
doc: Registration number of a company at the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC) of South Africa: the year of registration, a sequence number and a code for the type of company. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZA-CIP; with that prefix an identifier reads ZA-CIP-6713-713839-07.

name: South African identity number
doc: South African identity number: 13 digits made of the date of birth (YYMMDD), four digits, a citizenship digit, a digit that is usually 8 and a check digit.

name: South African corporate income tax number
doc: Income tax reference number of a company, trust or other body for corporate income tax at the South African Revenue Service. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZA-CIT; with that prefix an identifier reads ZA-CIT-9415005603.

name: South African nonprofit organisation number
doc: Registration number of a nonprofit organisation at the Nonprofit Organisation Directorate of the Department of Social Development of South Africa. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZA-NPO; with that prefix an identifier reads ZA-NPO-181-465.

name: South African province
doc: Name of one of the nine provinces of South Africa, such as Gauteng, Western Cape or KwaZulu-Natal. The code is the pattern za_province_code.

patterns.name: South African province code
patterns.doc: Code of a South African province from ISO 3166-2:ZA, without the ZA- prefix: EC, FS, GP, KZN, LP, MP, NC, NW or WC. Older data also uses GT for Gauteng, NL for KwaZulu-Natal and NP for Limpopo.

name: South African province code
doc: Code of a South African province from ISO 3166-2:ZA, without the ZA- prefix: EC, FS, GP, KZN, LP, MP, NC, NW or WC. Older data also uses GT for Gauteng, NL for KwaZulu-Natal and NP for Limpopo.

name: Zambian NGO registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation at the Department of the Registrar for NGOs of Zambia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZM-RNGO; with that prefix an identifier reads ZM-RNGO-1010147.

name: Zambian PACRA registration number
doc: Registration number of a company or business at the Patents and Companies Registration Agency (PACRA) of Zambia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZM-PCR; with that prefix an identifier reads ZM-PCR-320170016571.

name: Zambian society registration number
doc: Registration number of a society at the Registrar of Societies of Zambia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZM-RS; with that prefix an identifier reads ZM-RS-10235225.

name: Zimbabwean private voluntary organisation number
doc: Registration number of a private voluntary organisation in Zimbabwe. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZW-PVO; with that prefix an identifier reads ZW-PVO-15/2003.
